text.en: IMTFE judgment (1948), ch. V: the Mukden Incident of 18 September 1931 was 'carefully planned beforehand' by officers of the Army General Staff and the Kwantung Army to give an excuse for occupying Manchuria.
text.zh: 远东国际军事法庭判决书（1948）第五章：1931 年 9 月 18 日的九一八事变由日本陆军参谋本部和关东军军官“事先周密策划”，目的是为占领东北制造借口。

note.en: At the time Japan blamed Chinese troops and called its action self-defence; the League of Nations' Lytton Commission (1932) did not accept that claim.
note.zh: 事变当时日方指称中国军队破坏铁路，称自己是自卫；国际联盟李顿调查团（1932）没有接受这一说法。

text.en: US Department of State, Office of the Historian, 'The Mukden Incident of 1931 and the Stimson Doctrine': Japan declared Manchukuo an autonomous state in 1932, though it was under the control of the Japanese army; the Lytton report refused to recognise it.
text.zh: 美国国务院史官办公室《1931 年九一八事变与史汀生主义》：日本 1932 年宣布成立“满洲国”，实际由日本军队控制；李顿报告不承认其合法性。

text.en: IMTFE judgment (1948), ch. V: on 7 July 1937 Japanese troops attacked the walled town of Wanping near Peiping after the 'Marco Polo Bridge Incident'; the tribunal treats this as the start of the second phase of Japan's war in China.
text.zh: 远东国际军事法庭判决书（1948）第五章：1937 年 7 月 7 日“卢沟桥事变”后，日军进攻北平附近的宛平城；法庭将此视为日本对华战争第二阶段的开始。

text.en: Dick Wilson, When Tigers Fight: The Story of the Sino-Japanese War, 1937–1945 (Viking, 1982), p. 36: about 700,000 Chinese and 300,000 Japanese troops were committed at Shanghai.
text.zh: Dick Wilson，《When Tigers Fight: The Story of the Sino-Japanese War, 1937–1945》（Viking，1982），第 36 页：淞沪会战中国投入约 70 万人，日本约 30 万人。

note.en: Rounded totals of troops committed over the whole battle, not all present at once.
note.zh: 这是整场会战先后投入兵力的约数，并非同一时间在场的人数。

text.en: Peter Harmsen, Shanghai 1937: Stalingrad on the Yangtze (Casemate, 2013): the battle lasted from 13 August to 26 November 1937; a Chinese report to the War Council dated 5 November 1937 counted 187,200 killed and wounded (p. 247).
text.zh: Peter Harmsen，《Shanghai 1937: Stalingrad on the Yangtze》（Casemate，2013）：会战从 1937 年 8 月 13 日持续到 11 月 26 日；中方 1937 年 11 月 5 日呈报军事委员会的数字为死伤 187,200 人（第 247 页）。

note.en: The 5 November report covers only part of the battle; later Chinese and Japanese estimates of Chinese losses are higher (Harmsen cites a Japanese estimate of about 250,000 killed and wounded).
note.zh: 11 月 5 日的报告只统计到会战中段；后来中日双方对中国损失的估计更高（Harmsen 引日方估计约 25 万死伤）。

text.en: Benjamin Lai, Shanghai and Nanjing 1937: Massacre on the Yangtze (Osprey Campaign 309, 2017), p. 88: Japanese official war records give over 40,000 Japanese killed and wounded at Shanghai.
text.zh: Benjamin Lai，《Shanghai and Nanjing 1937: Massacre on the Yangtze》（Osprey Campaign 309，2017），第 88 页：据日本官方战史记录，日军在淞沪的死伤超过 4 万人。

note.en: Official figures exclude sickness; the count of 42,202 killed and wounded (11,072 killed) runs only to 8 November.
note.zh: 官方数字不含病员；死伤 42,202 人（其中阵亡 11,072 人）只统计到 11 月 8 日。

text.en: IMTFE judgment (1948), ch. VIII: over 200,000 civilians and prisoners of war were killed in Nanking and its vicinity in the first six weeks of the occupation; about 20,000 cases of rape occurred in the city in the first month; burial societies counted more than 155,000 bodies.
text.zh: 远东国际军事法庭判决书（1948）第八章：日军占领南京后最初六周内，在南京及附近被杀害的平民和战俘超过 20 万人；第一个月城内发生约 2 万起强奸案；慈善团体掩埋的尸体超过 15.5 万具。

note.en: Listed side by side with the Nanjing tribunal's figure [S8]; Atlas does not choose between them.
note.zh: 与南京审判的数字 [S8] 并列，本书不在两者之间取舍。

text.en: Judgment of the Nanjing War Crimes Tribunal of the Ministry of National Defence (case 1947 no. 1, against Tani Hisao, 10 March 1947): over 190,000 people killed in mass killings and over 150,000 bodies buried by charitable bodies; total victims over 300,000.
text.zh: 国防部审判战犯军事法庭判决（三十六年度审字第一号，谷寿夫案，1947 年 3 月 10 日）：集体屠杀 19 万余人，零星屠杀后经慈善机关收埋 15 万余具，被害总数达 30 万人以上。

note.en: Listed side by side with the IMTFE figure [S7].
note.zh: 与远东国际军事法庭的数字 [S7] 并列。

text.en: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Japan, 'Q&A: History issues', Q6: the Government of Japan believes it cannot be denied that the killing of non-combatants, looting and other acts occurred after the Japanese army entered Nanjing in 1937, but that there are numerous theories about the number of victims and it is difficult to determine the correct number.
text.zh: 日本外务省《历史问题问答》问 6：日本政府认为，1937 年日军进入南京后发生了杀害非战斗人员、掠夺等行为，这一点无法否认；但关于遇难人数有多种说法，政府认为难以判断哪个数字正确。

text.en: Japanese Monograph No. 179, Central China Area Operations Record 1937–1941 (US Army, Far East Command, translated Japanese official record), ch. II 'Wu-Han Operation': the 11th Army advanced up both banks of the Yangtze (Anking, Kiukiang, Tienchiachen) while the 2nd Army crossed the Tapieh mountains to the north; Hankou was entered on 25–27 October 1938.
text.zh: 《日本专题研究第 179 号：华中作战记录 1937–1941》（美国远东司令部译日方战史）第二章“武汉作战”：第 11 军沿长江两岸推进（安庆、九江、田家镇），第 2 军从北面越过大别山；1938 年 10 月 25 日至 27 日进入汉口。

text.en: Senshi Sōsho vol. 89, Shina jihen rikugun sakusen (2) (Japanese official war history, National Institute for Defense Studies): Japanese losses in the Wuhan operation about 9,500 killed and 26,000 wounded (2nd and 11th Armies).
text.zh: 《战史丛书》第 89 卷《支那事变陆军作战（2）》（日本防卫研究所官方战史）：武汉作战日军阵亡约 9,500 人，负伤约 2.6 万人（第 2 军与第 11 军合计）。

note.en: Figures taken from the volume as cited in the Japanese-language literature; illness (over 100,000 cases in the 11th Army) is counted separately.
note.zh: 数字据日文文献对该卷的引用；病员另计（第 11 军超过 10 万人次）。

text.en: Fujii Motohiro, 'The Nationalist Government's war leadership and military system in the expansion phase of the Sino-Japanese War', National Institute for Defense Studies (Japan): Chinese forces assembled for Wuhan reached about 90 divisions; the 9th War Zone reported about 200,000 killed, wounded and missing for June–November 1938.
text.zh: 藤井元博《日中战争扩大期中国国民政府的战争指导与军事体制》（日本防卫研究所）：为武汉会战集结的中国军队最终达约 90 个师；第九战区报告 1938 年 6 月至 11 月死伤失踪约 20 万人。

note.en: The 200,000 covers the 9th War Zone only, not all Chinese forces at Wuhan.
note.zh: 20 万只是第九战区的统计，不是武汉会战中国军队的全部损失。

text.en: Rana Mitter, China's War with Japan, 1937–1945: The Struggle for Survival (Allen Lane / Penguin, 2013; US title Forgotten Ally): between 14 and 20 million Chinese died in the war of 1937–1945.
text.zh: Rana Mitter，《China's War with Japan, 1937–1945: The Struggle for Survival》（Allen Lane／Penguin，2013；美国版名《Forgotten Ally》）：1937–1945 年战争中，中国死亡 1,400 万至 2,000 万人。

note.en: Estimates differ because records of civilian deaths, famine and refugees are incomplete.
note.zh: 由于平民死亡、饥荒和难民的记录不完整，各家估计不一。

text.en: The National WWII Museum (New Orleans), 'Research Starters: Worldwide Deaths in World War II', table of military and total (military and civilian) deaths: China 3–4 million military, about 20 million total; Soviet Union 8.8–10.7 million military, 24 million total; Poland 5.6 million total; Germany 6.6–8.8 million total; Japan 2.6–3.1 million total; India 1.5–2.5 million; Dutch East Indies 3–4 million; Malaya 100,000; Singapore 50,000; United Kingdom 450,700; United States 418,500; worldwide about 15 million battle deaths and 45 million civilian deaths.
text.zh: 美国国家二战博物馆（新奥尔良）《二战全球死亡人数》，军人死亡与军民合计死亡表：中国军人 300 万至 400 万，合计约 2,000 万；苏联军人 880 万至 1,070 万，合计 2,400 万；波兰合计 560 万；德国合计 660 万至 880 万；日本合计 260 万至 310 万；印度 150 万至 250 万；荷属东印度 300 万至 400 万；马来亚 10 万；新加坡 5 万；英国 450,700；美国 418,500；全世界战斗死亡约 1,500 万、平民死亡约 4,500 万。

note.en: The museum notes that worldwide estimates 'vary widely in several sources' and that civilian deaths in China alone might be far higher. Totals of 70–85 million, often quoted, add deaths from war-related famine and disease to the direct toll; Atlas could not trace that range to a single primary source and gives it as the upper end of estimates.
note.zh: 该馆注明，全球估计“各家差别很大”，仅中国的平民死亡就可能高得多。常被引用的 7,000 万至 8,500 万这个总数，是在直接死亡之外加上战争造成的饥荒和疾病死亡；本图集未能把这个区间追溯到单一的原始来源，只把它作为估计的上限列出。

text.en: Ministry of Health, Labour and Welfare of Japan, 'Recovery of remains in China proper' (2026): about 465,700 Japanese war dead in China proper (excluding north-east China), including about 23,500 lost at sea.
text.zh: 日本厚生劳动省《中国本土遗骨收容实施状况》（2026）：在中国本土（不含东北）死亡的日本人约 465,700 人，其中海上死亡约 23,500 人。

text.en: Caixin Global, 11 January 2017: China's Ministry of Education ordered textbooks to present the War of Resistance as a 14-year war beginning with the '918 Incident' of 18 September 1931, instead of eight years from 7 July 1937.
text.zh: 财新国际版 2017 年 1 月 11 日：中国教育部要求教材把抗日战争写为从 1931 年“九一八事变”开始的十四年抗战，而不是从 1937 年 7 月 7 日算起的八年。

text.en: Foreign Relations of the United States, 1941, vol. V, doc. 592 (Ambassador Gauss, Chongqing, 11 December 1941): by proclamations of 9 December 1941 China formally declared war on Japan and declared a state of war with Germany and Italy.
text.zh: 《美国对外关系文件》1941 年第五卷第 592 号（驻华大使高斯，重庆，1941 年 12 月 11 日）：中国国民政府 1941 年 12 月 9 日布告，正式对日宣战，并宣布与德国、意大利处于战争状态。

text.en: Singapore Chinese Cultural Centre, Culturepaedia, 'Ee Hoe Hean Club': the Nanyang Federation of China Relief Fund was founded on 10 October 1938 with Tan Kah Kee as president; in 1939 it sent more than 3,200 Nanyang drivers and mechanics to the Burma Road.
text.zh: 新加坡华族文化中心《文化百科》“怡和轩俱乐部”：南洋华侨筹赈祖国难民总会于 1938 年 10 月 10 日成立，陈嘉庚任主席；1939 年该会组织 3,200 多名南洋机工赴滇缅公路服务。

text.en: China News Service, 26 June 2019: 3,192 overseas Chinese drivers and mechanics from Nanyang served on the Burma Road from 1939; more than 1,000 of them died there.
text.zh: 中国新闻网 2019 年 6 月 26 日：1939 年起，3,192 名南洋华侨机工在滇缅公路服务，1,000 多人牺牲在这条公路上。

note.en: Singapore and Chinese sources give 'more than 3,200' and '3,192' for the same group; 'about 3,200' is used in the text.
note.zh: 新加坡和中国的资料分别写“3,200 多名”和“3,192 名”，正文取“约 3,200 人”。

text.en: Japanese strength on the Beiping–Hankou railway, autumn 1937: about 300,000, as estimated in the Republic of China Ministry of National Defence official history Kangri zhanshi: Pinghan tielu beiduan yanxian zhi zuozhan (1962), pp. 34–35 (297,347).
text.zh: 1937 年秋平汉铁路北段日军兵力约 30 万：据中华民国国防部史政局《抗日战史：平汉铁路北段沿线之作战》（1962）第 34–35 页的估计（297,347 人）。

note.en: A Chinese official estimate based partly on establishment strengths; no Japanese total survives (Japanese Monograph 70 notes the lack of strength reports). Used only for the width of the route line.
note.zh: 这是中方官方战史的估计，部分按编制员额计算；日方没有留下总兵力记录（日本专题研究第 70 号说明缺少兵力报告）。只用于路线线宽。

text.en: Japanese strength in the Wuhan operation, 1938: about 300,000 (11th and 2nd Armies, about nine divisions plus detachments, from the order of battle in Japanese Monograph No. 179).
text.zh: 1938 年武汉作战日军兵力约 30 万（第 11 军和第 2 军，约九个师团加若干支队，据日本专题研究第 179 号的战斗序列）。

note.en: Order of magnitude only: Japanese-language accounts give 'over 300,000' and Chinese accounts 350,000–400,000; no single verified headcount was found. Used only for the width of the route line.
note.zh: 只是数量级：日文资料写“30 万以上”，中文资料写 35 万至 40 万，没有找到可核实的单一统计。只用于路线线宽。

text.en: US Military Academy, Department of History, 'China, 1941: Chinese territory seized prior to July 1937 and major Japanese drives in 1937' (public domain; via Wikimedia Commons). Route source for japan-north-china and japan-shanghai-nanjing.
text.zh: 美国西点军校历史系地图《1941 年的中国：1937 年 7 月前被占的中国领土与 1937 年日军主要攻势》（公有领域，维基共享资源）。华北与上海—南京两条路线的依据。

text.en: US Military Academy, Department of History, 'Malaya, 1941: Japanese centrifugal offensive, December 1941 – January 1942' (map 7b, public domain; via Wikimedia Commons): Twenty-Fifth Army routes and dates (Jitra 11–12 December, Kuala Lumpur 11 January, Kuantan 1–3 January, British forces on Singapore island 31 January). Route source for the three Malaya movements.
text.zh: 美国西点军校历史系地图《1941 年马来亚：日军的离心攻势，1941 年 12 月至 1942 年 1 月》（7b，公有领域，维基共享资源）：第 25 军路线与日期（日得拉 12 月 11–12 日、吉隆坡 1 月 11 日、关丹 1 月 1–3 日、英军 1 月 31 日退入新加坡岛）。三条马来亚路线的依据。

text.en: 'Track of carrier task force for Pearl Harbor attack, 26 November – 23 December 1941', Reports of General MacArthur, vol. II (US Army, 1966; public domain; via Wikimedia Commons). Route source for kido-butai.
text.zh: 《珍珠港攻击机动部队航迹图（1941 年 11 月 26 日至 12 月 23 日）》，《麦克阿瑟将军报告》第二卷（美国陆军，1966；公有领域，维基共享资源）。机动部队航线的依据。

text.en: S. Woodburn Kirby, The War Against Japan, vol. I: The Loss of Singapore (HMSO, 1957), p. 97 table: the landing in Malaya was planned for 00:45 local time on 8 December (17:15 GMT on the 7th), the attack on Pearl Harbor for 07:55 Hawaii time (18:25 GMT), about 70 minutes later; the Singora landing for 02:30 local time.
text.zh: S. Woodburn Kirby，《对日战争》第一卷《新加坡的失陷》（英国皇家文书局，1957），第 97 页表：马来亚登陆计划在 12 月 8 日当地时间 0 时 45 分（格林尼治 7 日 17 时 15 分），珍珠港攻击在夏威夷时间 7 时 55 分（格林尼治 18 时 25 分），晚约 70 分钟；宋卡登陆在当地时间 2 时 30 分。

note.en: Kirby notes conflicting evidence on the exact time of the first landing at Kota Bharu; it was probably close to the planned time.
note.zh: Kirby 指出哥打巴鲁第一批登陆的确切时间说法不一，大概接近计划时间。

text.en: Kirby, The War Against Japan, vol. I, Appendix 18, p. 527: Japanese first flights landed about 13,500 men at Singora, 7,550 at Patani and 5,590 at Kota Bharu, 26,640 in all (17,230 combat troops).
text.zh: Kirby《对日战争》第一卷附录 18（第 527 页）：日军第一批在宋卡登陆约 13,500 人，北大年 7,550 人，哥打巴鲁 5,590 人，共 26,640 人（战斗部队 17,230 人）。

text.en: Kirby, The War Against Japan, vol. I, Appendix 18, p. 527: approximate Japanese strength in Malaya on 8 February 1942: 67,660 combat troops, 33,000 service troops, 10,000 air and air-service troops, total 110,660; 168 guns and 150 tanks.
text.zh: Kirby《对日战争》第一卷附录 18（第 527 页）：1942 年 2 月 8 日日军在马来亚兵力约为战斗部队 67,660 人、勤务部队 33,000 人、航空部队 10,000 人，共 110,660 人；火炮 168 门，坦克 150 辆。

text.en: Kirby, The War Against Japan, vol. I, pp. 159–163: the regular and volunteer forces in Malaya totalled about 88,600 — 19,600 British, 15,200 Australian, 37,000 Indian and some 16,800 locally enlisted Asians; there were 158 first-line aircraft when war began.
text.zh: Kirby《对日战争》第一卷第 159–163 页：马来亚正规军和志愿部队共约 88,600 人——英国 19,600 人、澳大利亚 15,200 人、印度 37,000 人、本地招募的亚洲人约 16,800 人；开战时一线飞机 158 架。

text.en: Kirby, The War Against Japan, vol. I, p. 362: after the withdrawal to the island the Singapore garrison was about 85,000 men, including some 15,000 base, administrative and non-combatant troops.
text.zh: Kirby《对日战争》第一卷第 362 页：撤到岛上之后，新加坡守军约 85,000 人，其中约 15,000 人是后勤、行政和非战斗人员。

text.en: Kirby, The War Against Japan, vol. I, pp. 198–199: 10 December 1941, Prince of Wales (110 officers, 1,502 ratings; 90 and 1,195 rescued) and Repulse (69 officers, 1,240 ratings; 42 and 754 rescued) were sunk off Kuantan; Japan lost three aircraft.
text.zh: Kirby《对日战争》第一卷第 198–199 页：1941 年 12 月 10 日，威尔士亲王号（军官 110 人、士兵 1,502 人，获救 90 人和 1,195 人）与反击号（军官 69 人、士兵 1,240 人，获救 42 人和 754 人）在关丹外海被击沉；日方损失飞机 3 架。

note.en: From these figures about 840 men were lost: 327 from Prince of Wales and 513 from Repulse.
note.zh: 按这些数字计算，约 840 人丧生：威尔士亲王号 327 人，反击号 513 人。

text.en: Kirby, The War Against Japan, vol. I, p. 473: British Commonwealth battle casualties in the Malayan campaign were 138,708 (British 38,496, Australian 18,490, Indian 67,340, local volunteers 14,382), of whom more than 130,000 were prisoners of war; Japanese battle casualties in their official records were 9,824.
text.zh: Kirby《对日战争》第一卷第 473 页：英联邦军队在马来亚战役的战斗损失为 138,708 人（英国 38,496、澳大利亚 18,490、印度 67,340、本地志愿部队 14,382），其中 13 万多人成为战俘；日本官方记录的日军战斗伤亡为 9,824 人。

text.en: Kirby, The War Against Japan, vol. I, pp. 150–151: Hong Kong capitulated on 25 December 1941; the fighting and the capitulation cost 11,848 combatants, with about 4,440 battle casualties; official Japanese casualties were 675 killed and 2,079 wounded (2,754).
text.zh: Kirby《对日战争》第一卷第 150–151 页：香港于 1941 年 12 月 25 日投降；战斗与投降共损失作战人员 11,848 人，其中战斗伤亡约 4,440 人；日本官方记录日军阵亡 675 人、负伤 2,079 人（共 2,754 人）。

note.en: Kirby notes the British battle-casualty figure may be an underestimate (hospitals treated about 4,000 wounded).
note.zh: Kirby 指出英方战斗伤亡数字可能偏低（医院收治伤员约 4,000 人）。

text.en: Kirby, The War Against Japan, vol. I, p. 99: at Pearl Harbor 2,403 US Navy, Marine Corps, Army personnel and civilians were killed and 1,178 wounded; all eight battleships were sunk or put out of action; Japan lost 29 aircraft.
text.zh: Kirby《对日战争》第一卷第 99 页：珍珠港美国海军、海军陆战队、陆军人员和平民 2,403 人死亡，1,178 人受伤；八艘战列舰全部被击沉或失去战斗力；日方损失飞机 29 架。

text.en: Kirby, The War Against Japan, vol. I, p. 361: Singapore's fixed coastal defences had been sited against attack from the sea; not all guns could be brought to bear to the north, and their ammunition was armour-piercing for use against ships; the 9.2-inch guns had a limited amount of high-explosive ammunition.
text.zh: Kirby《对日战争》第一卷第 361 页：新加坡的固定海岸炮台是为防御海上进攻而设；并非所有炮都能转向北面，弹药是对付舰船的穿甲弹；9.2 英寸炮只有少量适合打陆上目标的高爆弹。

text.en: Kirby, The War Against Japan, vol. I, pp. 411, 414–415: on the morning of 14 February the water engineer reported that breaks in the mains were losing more than half the supply, which might last 24–48 hours; at 5.15 p.m. on 15 February 1942 Percival met Yamashita at the Ford factory at Bukit Timah; he signed the terms at 6.10 p.m.; fighting ceased at 8.30 p.m., ending a campaign of 70 days.
text.zh: Kirby《对日战争》第一卷第 411、414–415 页：2 月 14 日早上水务工程师报告水管破裂使一半以上供水流失，最多维持 24–48 小时；1942 年 2 月 15 日下午 5 时 15 分，白思华在武吉知马的福特车厂会见山下奉文，6 时 10 分签字；晚 8 时 30 分停火，战役历时 70 天。

text.en: Kirby, The War Against Japan, vol. I, pp. 183, 323: during the first raid on 8 December 1941 Singapore was fully lit and the street lamps were not put out until the all-clear at 4.40 a.m.; known civilian casualties from air raids during January 1942 were some 600 killed and 1,500 injured.
text.zh: Kirby《对日战争》第一卷第 183、323 页：1941 年 12 月 8 日首次空袭时新加坡灯火通明，路灯到凌晨 4 时 40 分解除警报后才熄灭；1942 年 1 月空袭已知的平民伤亡约为 600 人死亡、1,500 人受伤。

note.en: A Singapore government account gives more than 1,000 killed in January [S37]; both are listed.
note.zh: 新加坡政府的资料写 1 月死亡 1,000 多人 [S37]；两者并列。

text.en: SG101 (Government of Singapore), 'First Japanese air raid in Singapore on 8 Dec 1941': 17 bombers attacked the city and air bases; the raid left 61 dead and 133 injured; by January 1942 there were two to three raids a day, killing more than 1,000 people that month.
text.zh: SG101（新加坡政府）《1941 年 12 月 8 日日军首次空袭新加坡》：17 架轰炸机袭击市区和机场，造成 61 人死亡、133 人受伤；到 1942 年 1 月每天有两三次空袭，当月 1,000 多人死亡。

text.en: SG101 (Government of Singapore), 'Overcrowding in Alexandra Military Hospital on 14 Feb 1942': Japanese soldiers bayoneted 50 unarmed patients and medical staff in the wards; about 200 patients and staff were marched to another building, held overnight and shot the next day.
text.zh: SG101（新加坡政府）《1942 年 2 月 14 日人满为患的亚历山大军医院》：日军士兵在病房里用刺刀杀死 50 名手无寸铁的病人和医护人员；约 200 名病人和医护人员被押到另一栋楼，关押一夜，次日被枪杀。

note.en: Kirby records the Japanese justification that the hospital had been used as an artillery position (Kirby, vol. I, p. 414).
note.zh: Kirby 记录了日方的说法：医院曾被用作炮兵阵地（Kirby 第一卷第 414 页）。

text.en: Roots.sg (National Heritage Board, Singapore), 'Lieutenant Adnan and the Battle of Bukit Chandu': on 13–14 February 1942 C Company, 1st Battalion, Malay Regiment, held Bukit Chandu; Second Lieutenant Adnan Saidi was captured and killed.
text.zh: Roots.sg（新加坡国家文物局）《阿南中尉与武吉知卓之战》：1942 年 2 月 13–14 日，马来军团第一营 C 连守卫武吉知卓；阿南·赛迪少尉被俘后遇害。

text.en: Roots.sg (National Heritage Board), 'Former Racecourse' (Farrer Park): two days after the British surrender the Japanese assembled the British Indian troops at Farrer Park and urged them to join the Indian National Army.
text.zh: Roots.sg（新加坡国家文物局）“旧赛马场”（花拉公园）：英军投降两天后，日军把英属印度部队集中在花拉公园，劝他们加入印度国民军。

text.en: Roots.sg (National Heritage Board), 'Indian National Army Memorial': the INA was set up in 1942 with Japanese assistance, first under Captain Mohan Singh and later under Subhas Chandra Bose; it was dissolved with Japan's defeat in 1945.
text.zh: Roots.sg（新加坡国家文物局）“印度国民军纪念碑”：印度国民军于 1942 年在日本协助下成立，先由莫汉·辛格上尉领导，后由苏巴斯·钱德拉·鲍斯领导；1945 年随日本战败解散。

text.en: Kirby, The War Against Japan, vol. I, pp. 103, 449: Bataan surrendered on 9 April 1942 and Corregidor on 6 May; in Java, Allied units were ordered to lay down their arms on 8 March 1942 after the Dutch commander's surrender broadcast.
text.zh: Kirby《对日战争》第一卷第 103、449 页：巴丹于 1942 年 4 月 9 日投降，科雷希多 5 月 6 日投降；在爪哇，荷军司令发表投降广播后，盟军部队于 1942 年 3 月 8 日奉命放下武器。

text.en: SG101 (Government of Singapore), 'Singapore fell on 15 Feb 1942': at 5.15 p.m. Percival went to the Ford factory; the surrender began three years and eight months of occupation; 15 February is marked as Total Defence Day.
text.zh: SG101（新加坡政府）《1942 年 2 月 15 日新加坡沦陷》：下午 5 时 15 分白思华前往福特车厂；投降之后是三年零八个月的占领；2 月 15 日定为全面防卫日。

text.en: Kirby, The War Against Japan, vol. I, pp. 280–281 and 289: at the Slim River on 7 January 1942 a Japanese tank column broke through; 12th Indian Brigade virtually ceased to exist and 28th Brigade was reduced to a third; Japanese troops entered Kuala Lumpur at 8 p.m. on 11 January.
text.zh: Kirby《对日战争》第一卷第 280–281、289 页：1942 年 1 月 7 日日军坦克纵队在仕林河突破；印度第 12 旅几乎不复存在，第 28 旅只剩三分之一；1 月 11 日晚 8 时日军进入吉隆坡。

text.en: Kirby, The War Against Japan, vol. I, pp. 340, 374–375: III Corps had crossed to the island by 5.30 a.m. on 31 January 1942 and a 60-yard gap was blown in the Causeway; at about 10.30 p.m. on 8 February Japanese landing craft attacked the north-west coast held by 22nd Australian Brigade, the heaviest assaults north of Pulau Sarimbun.
text.zh: Kirby《对日战争》第一卷第 340、374–375 页：1942 年 1 月 31 日清晨 5 时 30 分第三军全部撤到岛上，长堤被炸开 60 码缺口；2 月 8 日晚约 10 时 30 分，日军登陆艇进攻澳大利亚第 22 旅防守的西北海岸，最猛烈的进攻在沙林汶岛以北。

text.en: Kirby, The War Against Japan, vol. I, pp. 364, 524: 'Dalforce', a small force of Chinese irregulars of all classes and political opinions, was expanded for the defence of the island; Japanese air forces supporting 25th Army totalled about 560 aircraft.
text.zh: Kirby《对日战争》第一卷第 364、524 页：由各阶层、各政治立场华人组成的非正规部队“星华义勇军（Dalforce）”在保卫新加坡岛时扩编；支援第 25 军的日本航空兵力共约 560 架飞机。

text.en: Kirby, The War Against Japan, vol. I, pp. 176–177: the Japanese 56th Infantry Regiment, after the Kota Bharu landing, was to move south by the coastal route towards Kuantan; 5th Division used the Singora–Alor Star road and its 42nd Regiment the Patani–Kroh road.
text.zh: Kirby《对日战争》第一卷第 176–177 页：日军第 56 联队在哥打巴鲁登陆后沿海岸路线南下关丹；第 5 师团主力走宋卡—亚罗士打公路，第 42 联队走北大年—高乌公路。

text.en: Kirby, The War Against Japan, vol. I, pp. 302, 359, 465: the Japanese made full use of bicycles to keep up the advance (in mid-January a battalion on bicycles, with tanks, led the advance into Johor); the town of Singapore's peacetime population of about 550,000 had nearly doubled with refugees by the end of January 1942.
text.zh: Kirby《对日战争》第一卷第 302、359、465 页：日军充分利用自行车保持推进速度（1 月中旬一个骑自行车的步兵营在坦克支援下打头阵进入柔佛）；到 1942 年 1 月底，新加坡市区原本约 55 万的人口因难民涌入几乎翻了一番。

text.en: Treaty of Versailles (1919), Part V, Article 160: the German Army was not to exceed seven infantry and three cavalry divisions, and its total strength 100,000 men including 4,000 officers.
text.zh: 《凡尔赛条约》（1919）第五部分第 160 条：德国陆军不得超过 7 个步兵师和 3 个骑兵师，总兵力不得超过 10 万人，其中军官不超过 4,000 人。

text.en: Robert M. Kennedy, The German Campaign in Poland (1939), Department of the Army Pamphlet 20-255 (1956), ch. 1–3, pp. 5–7, 17, 41: Hitler was appointed Chancellor on 30 January 1933; Austria was annexed in March 1938; at Munich on 29 September 1938 Britain, France, Germany and Italy agreed the cession of the Sudeten areas, with Czechoslovakia not represented, after British and French attempts to enlist Soviet support had failed — Germany took areas with 3,500,000 people, 700,000 of them Czechs; Bohemia and Moravia were occupied on 15 March 1939; on 31 March 1939 Britain and France pledged to assist Poland if attacked; in the summer of 1939 British and French negotiations in Moscow for a common front against Germany were slow and the Soviet Union committed itself to no coalition.
text.zh: Robert M. Kennedy，《德国对波兰的战役（1939）》，美国陆军部第 20-255 号小册子（1956），第 1–3 章，第 5–7、17、41 页：希特勒 1933 年 1 月 30 日出任总理；1938 年 3 月吞并奥地利；1938 年 9 月 29 日英、法、德、意在慕尼黑商定割让苏台德地区，捷克斯洛伐克没有代表在场，此前英法争取苏联支持的努力没有成功——德国取得的地区有 350 万人口，其中 70 万是捷克人；1939 年 3 月 15 日德军占领波希米亚和摩拉维亚；1939 年 3 月 31 日英法承诺波兰遭到进攻时给予援助；1939 年夏英法在莫斯科谈判组成对德共同阵线，进展缓慢，苏联没有承诺加入任何联盟。

text.en: Munich Agreement, 29 September 1938 (text, Avalon Project, Yale Law School): signed by Hitler, Chamberlain, Daladier and Mussolini; the evacuation of the Sudeten German territory was to begin on 1 October and be completed by 10 October.
text.zh: 《慕尼黑协定》，1938 年 9 月 29 日（文本，耶鲁大学法学院 Avalon 项目）：希特勒、张伯伦、达拉第、墨索里尼签字；苏台德德意志人地区的撤出于 10 月 1 日开始，10 月 10 日前完成。

text.en: Secret Additional Protocol to the German–Soviet Non-Aggression Treaty, Moscow, 23 August 1939 (text, Avalon Project): the northern boundary of Lithuania was to divide the German and Soviet spheres in the Baltic; in Poland the line of the rivers Narew, Vistula and San; the Soviet side declared its interest in Bessarabia; the protocol was to be kept strictly secret.
text.zh: 《德苏互不侵犯条约》秘密附加议定书，莫斯科，1939 年 8 月 23 日（文本，Avalon 项目）：波罗的海地区以立陶宛北部边界划分德苏势力范围；在波兰以纳雷夫河、维斯瓦河、桑河一线划分；苏方表明对比萨拉比亚的利益；议定书须严格保密。

text.en: Resolution of the Congress of People's Deputies of the USSR, 24 December 1989, on the political and legal assessment of the 1939 Soviet–German Non-Aggression Treaty: it confirms that the secret protocol was signed and existed, condemns it, and declares the secret protocols legally unjustified and invalid from the moment of signing.
text.zh: 苏联人民代表大会 1989 年 12 月 24 日《关于 1939 年苏德互不侵犯条约的政治和法律评价》决议：确认秘密议定书确实签订并存在，予以谴责，宣布各项秘密议定书在法律上站不住脚，自签字之时起无效。

text.en: United States Holocaust Memorial Museum, Holocaust Encyclopedia, 'Axis Powers in World War II': on 1 November 1936 Mussolini announced a Rome–Berlin 'axis'; Germany and Japan signed the Anti-Comintern Pact on 25 November 1936; Germany, Italy and Japan signed the Tripartite Pact on 27 September 1940.
text.zh: 美国大屠杀纪念馆《大屠杀百科》“二战中的轴心国”：1936 年 11 月 1 日墨索里尼宣布罗马—柏林“轴心”；1936 年 11 月 25 日德日签订《反共产国际协定》；1940 年 9 月 27 日德、意、日签订《三国同盟条约》。

note.en: The museum's site timed out from this workstation; the article text was checked through search-engine extracts.
note.zh: 从本机访问该馆网站超时；条目内容通过搜索引擎摘录核对。

text.en: Roots.sg (National Heritage Board, Singapore), 'Sembawang Naval Base (King George VI Dock)': construction began in 1928; the base was officially opened on 14 February 1938 together with the King George VI Dock; it made Singapore an 'impregnable fortress', also called the 'Gibraltar of the East'.
text.zh: Roots.sg（新加坡国家文物局）“三巴旺海军基地（乔治六世船坞）”：1928 年动工，1938 年 2 月 14 日与乔治六世船坞同时正式启用；它让新加坡被称为“坚不可摧的堡垒”“东方直布罗陀”。

text.en: Kirby, The War Against Japan, vol. I, pp. 18, 28: British planning assumed a fleet would reach Singapore within 70 days of the outbreak of war (the 'period before relief'); in September 1939 the Chiefs of Staff increased the period to 180 days.
text.zh: Kirby《对日战争》第一卷第 18、28 页：英国的防务计划假定开战后 70 天内舰队可以开到新加坡（“待援期”）；1939 年 9 月参谋长委员会把这一期限延长到 180 天。

text.en: US Census Bureau, International Programs, 'Historical Estimates of World Population': estimates of world population in 1940 cluster around 2.3 billion.
text.zh: 美国人口普查局国际项目《世界人口历史估计》：1940 年世界人口的各家估计集中在约 23 亿。

text.en: Kennedy, The German Campaign in Poland (1939), pp. 25, 51–53, 57: in 1939 the active German Army numbered about 730,000 and its reserve about 1,100,000; Germany had 102 divisions, about 3,000 tanks and more than 4,000 aircraft; the peacetime Polish Army had a ceiling of 280,000, with 1,500,000 reservists available on mobilization, and the Polish air force had 935 aircraft, many of them obsolete.
text.zh: Kennedy《德国对波兰的战役（1939）》第 25、51–53、57 页：1939 年德国现役陆军约 73 万人，预备役约 110 万；德国共有 102 个师、约 3,000 辆坦克、4,000 多架飞机；波兰和平时期陆军员额上限 28 万人，动员时可征召预备役 150 万人，波兰空军有飞机 935 架，其中许多已经过时。

text.en: Biennial Report of the Chief of Staff of the United States Army, July 1, 1939 to June 30, 1941 (George C. Marshall): on 1 July 1939 the active Army of the United States consisted of approximately 174,000 enlisted men.
text.zh: 美国陆军参谋长两年度报告（1939 年 7 月 1 日至 1941 年 6 月 30 日，马歇尔）：1939 年 7 月 1 日美国现役陆军约有士兵 17.4 万人。

text.en: Kennedy, The German Campaign in Poland (1939), pp. 44–45, 74, 77, 81–82, 88, 113, 118–120, 123: on the evening of 31 August SS men staged a fake Polish attack on the German radio station at Gleiwitz, leaving behind condemned prisoners in Polish uniforms who had been killed; on 31 August 1939 the German force against Poland comprised 55 divisions, with 630,000 men in Army Group North and 886,000 in Army Group South; Warsaw capitulated on 27 September (140,000 troops); the last Polish force surrendered at Kock on 6 October; the final German–Soviet demarcation line ran along the Pisa, Narew, Bug and San; German Army losses were 8,082 killed, 27,278 wounded and 5,029 missing; the Germans claimed 694,000 prisoners of some 800,000 Polish soldiers; Soviet troops crossed the frontier at 6 a.m. on 17 September; Polish cavalry charged German armour in the Corridor; the Polish air force was destroyed or driven off in the first days; the Polish President and commander-in-chief fled to Romania.
text.zh: Kennedy《德国对波兰的战役（1939）》第 44–45、74、77、81–82、88、113、118–120、123 页：8 月 31 日晚，党卫队在德国格莱维茨电台制造了“波兰人袭击”的假事件，现场留下穿着波兰军服、已被杀死的死囚；1939 年 8 月 31 日德国对波兰共部署 55 个师，北方集团军群 63 万人，南方集团军群 88.6 万人；华沙 9 月 27 日投降（14 万人）；最后一支波兰部队 10 月 6 日在科克投降；德苏最终分界线沿皮萨河、纳雷夫河、布格河和桑河；德国陆军阵亡 8,082 人、负伤 27,278 人、失踪 5,029 人；德方称俘虏 69.4 万人（波兰参战军人约 80 万）；苏军 9 月 17 日早 6 时越过边界；波兰骑兵在走廊地区向德军装甲部队冲锋；波兰空军在开战头几天就被摧毁或被迫撤离；波兰总统和总司令逃往罗马尼亚。

text.en: Institute of National Remembrance (IPN, Poland), 'Soviet aggression on Poland from 17 September 1939': the Soviets used more than 600,000 soldiers, about 4,700 tanks and 3,300 combat aircraft; some 250,000 Polish soldiers were taken prisoner by the Soviets.
text.zh: 波兰国家记忆研究所（IPN）《1939 年 9 月 17 日苏联对波兰的侵略》：苏联动用 60 多万军人、约 4,700 辆坦克和 3,300 架作战飞机；约 25 万名波兰军人被苏军俘虏。

note.en: The IPN site refused connections from this workstation; the figures were checked through search-engine extracts of the IPN page. Other estimates of the Soviet force range from about 450,000 to 800,000.
note.zh: IPN 网站拒绝本机连接；数字通过搜索引擎对该页的摘录核对。对苏军兵力的其他估计在约 45 万到 80 万之间。

text.en: Brian Crozier, 'Remembering Katyn', Hoover Institution, 30 April 2000: the executions were ordered by Stalin in a decision of 5 March 1940 on Beria's proposal; KGB chairman Shelepin's 1959 memo to Khrushchev gives 21,857 killed, including 4,421 in the Katyn forest; German occupation forces found the mass grave at Katyn in 1943; the Soviet Union blamed Germany until 13 April 1990, when it admitted responsibility.
text.zh: Brian Crozier《记住卡廷》，胡佛研究所，2000 年 4 月 30 日：处决由斯大林根据贝利亚的提议于 1940 年 3 月 5 日决定；克格勃主席谢列平 1959 年给赫鲁晓夫的报告列出被处决者 21,857 人，其中卡廷森林 4,421 人；1943 年占领当地的德军发现了卡廷的万人坑；苏联一直归咎于德国，直到 1990 年 4 月 13 日才承认负有责任。

text.en: United States Holocaust Memorial Museum, Holocaust Encyclopedia, 'Jewish Losses during the Holocaust: By Country': Poland's Jewish population was 3,350,000 in 1937; between 2,770,000 and 3,000,000 were killed.
text.zh: 美国大屠杀纪念馆《大屠杀百科》“大屠杀中的犹太人损失（按国家）”：1937 年波兰犹太人 335 万，其中 277 万至 300 万人被杀害。

note.en: Checked through search-engine extracts (the museum's site timed out).
note.zh: 通过搜索引擎摘录核对（该馆网站访问超时）。

text.en: United States Holocaust Memorial Museum, Holocaust Encyclopedia, 'Polish Victims': an estimated 1.8 to 1.9 million non-Jewish Polish civilians were killed by the German occupation and the war.
text.zh: 美国大屠杀纪念馆《大屠杀百科》“波兰受害者”：估计有 180 万至 190 万非犹太裔波兰平民死于德国占领和战争。

note.en: Checked through search-engine extracts (the museum's site timed out).
note.zh: 通过搜索引擎摘录核对（该馆网站访问超时）。

text.en: T. K. Derry, The Campaign in Norway (HMSO, 1952), pp. 19, 27, 206, 176, 230: the Germans landed a first echelon of 8,850 men carried in warships, the Oslo group via the Baltic and the others from Wilhelmshaven, on 9 April 1940; the Allied assault on Narvik was made on 28 May; the evacuation of the Narvik area was completed on 8 June; land casualties were 1,869 British and about 530 French and Polish; Norwegian casualties 1,335; the German General Staff's figure was 5,296.
text.zh: T. K. Derry《挪威战役》（英国皇家文书局，1952），第 19、27、206、176、230 页：1940 年 4 月 9 日德军第一梯队 8,850 人由军舰运送登陆，奥斯陆一路经波罗的海，其他各路从威廉港出发；盟军 5 月 28 日进攻纳尔维克；6 月 8 日完成从纳尔维克地区撤离；陆上伤亡英军 1,869 人，法军和波兰军约 530 人，挪威军 1,335 人，德国总参谋部统计德军 5,296 人。

text.en: L. F. Ellis, The War in France and Flanders 1939–1940 (HMSO, 1953), pp. 20, 32, 35, 41–42, 80, 208, 247, 274, 294, 298, 326: during the winter of 1939–40 British brigades took turns on the Saar front in front of the Maginot forts; two months after the partition of Poland the Soviet Union invaded Finland, which fought until it sought an armistice in March 1940; on 10 May German troops crossed into Belgium, Holland and Luxembourg; the French command had thought the Ardennes 'impracticable for tanks'; German armour crossed the Meuse on 13 May; the 2nd Panzer Division reached Abbeville on 20 May; Operation Dynamo evacuated 338,226 men from Dunkirk (26 May – 4 June), nearly 100,000 of them from the beaches, 139,097 of them Allied (mostly French) troops after the evacuation was opened to them; the Belgian Army capitulated on 28 May; in June the French still had the equivalent of thirteen fortress divisions in the Maginot Line and on the Swiss frontier; Italy declared war on 10 June; on 14 June the Germans were entering Paris; British Army casualties in the campaign were 68,111.
text.zh: L. F. Ellis《法国和佛兰德斯的战争 1939–1940》（英国皇家文书局，1953），第 20、32、35、41–42、80、208、247、274、294、298、326 页：1939–40 年冬，英军各旅轮流在萨尔前线马奇诺要塞前方值守；瓜分波兰两个月后苏联入侵芬兰，芬兰一直打到 1940 年 3 月才求和；5 月 10 日德军越境进入比利时、荷兰和卢森堡；法军统帅部原以为阿登地区“坦克无法通行”；德军装甲部队 5 月 13 日渡过默兹河；德军第 2 装甲师 5 月 20 日到达阿布维尔；“发电机行动”从敦刻尔克撤出 338,226 人（5 月 26 日至 6 月 4 日），近 10 万人从海滩撤出，其中在撤离向盟军开放后撤出的盟军（主要是法军）139,097 人；比利时军队 5 月 28 日投降；到 6 月，法军仍有相当于 13 个要塞师的兵力留在马奇诺防线和瑞士边境；意大利 6 月 10 日宣战；6 月 14 日德军开进巴黎；英国陆军在这次战役中伤亡 68,111 人。

text.en: German High Command figures announced in July 1940, as reported in the Auckland Star, 4 July 1940 (Papers Past, National Library of New Zealand): German casualties in the West since 10 May were 27,074 killed, 111,034 wounded and 18,384 missing.
text.zh: 1940 年 7 月德国最高统帅部公布的数字，见《奥克兰星报》1940 年 7 月 4 日（新西兰国家图书馆 Papers Past）：5 月 10 日以来德军在西线阵亡 27,074 人，负伤 111,034 人，失踪 18,384 人。

note.en: A contemporary German official figure; the page blocks automated access and was checked through search-engine extracts. The German official history (K.-H. Frieser, The Blitzkrieg Legend) gives higher totals.
note.zh: 这是当时德方公布的官方数字；该网页拒绝自动访问，通过搜索引擎摘录核对。德国官方战史（Frieser《闪电战的传说》）给出的总数更高。

text.en: Nina Wardleworth (University of Leeds), 'What happened to the French army after Dunkirk', The Conversation, 2017: between 50,000 and 90,000 French soldiers were killed in May–June 1940 and about 1.8 million were taken prisoner; of about 340,000 Allied troops evacuated from Dunkirk, 123,000 were French.
text.zh: Nina Wardleworth（利兹大学）《敦刻尔克之后法军怎样了》，The Conversation，2017：1940 年 5–6 月法军阵亡 5 万至 9 万人，约 180 万人被俘；从敦刻尔克撤出的约 34 万盟军中有 12.3 万法国人。

text.en: Franco-German Armistice Agreement, Compiègne, 22 June 1940 (text, Avalon Project): signed at 6.50 p.m. German summer time by Keitel and Huntziger; French territory north and west of the line on the attached map to be occupied by German troops (Article II).
text.zh: 《法德停战协定》，贡比涅，1940 年 6 月 22 日（文本，Avalon 项目）：德国夏令时下午 6 时 50 分由凯特尔与洪齐格签字；附图线以北和以西的法国领土由德军占领（第二条）。

text.en: Public Sénat, 10 July 2019, on the commemoration of the 'Vichy 80': on 10 July 1940 the National Assembly gave Pétain's government full powers by 569 votes to 80, with 20 abstentions; the act served as the legal basis of the Vichy regime.
text.zh: Public Sénat 2019 年 7 月 10 日关于纪念“维希 80 人”的报道：1940 年 7 月 10 日国民议会以 569 票对 80 票、20 票弃权授予贝当政府全权；这项法律成了维希政权的法律基础。

text.en: Mémorial de la Shoah (Paris), 'June 18, 1940, the appeal of General de Gaulle': on 18 June 1940 de Gaulle, in London, broadcast on the BBC calling on French soldiers, engineers and technicians to join him in continuing the fight.
text.zh: 巴黎大屠杀纪念馆《1940 年 6 月 18 日，戴高乐将军的号召》：1940 年 6 月 18 日戴高乐在伦敦通过 BBC 广播，号召法国军人、工程师和技术人员与他一起继续战斗。

text.en: Royal Air Force, 'Battle of Britain' (raf.mod.uk): the battle was fought from 10 July to 31 October 1940; about 1,733 German aircraft were destroyed and 915 British; 544 pilots of Fighter Command (about one in six) were killed, and about 2,500 Luftwaffe airmen.
text.zh: 英国皇家空军《不列颠之战》（raf.mod.uk）：战役从 1940 年 7 月 10 日持续到 10 月 31 日；德国飞机约 1,733 架被毁，英国 915 架；战斗机司令部 544 名飞行员阵亡（约六分之一），德国空军约 2,500 名机组人员死亡。

note.en: The RAF site blocks automated access; the figures were checked through search-engine extracts of the page. Loss claims made during the battle were much higher on both sides.
note.zh: 皇家空军网站拒绝自动访问；数字通过搜索引擎对该页的摘录核对。战时双方宣称的战果都大大高于这些数字。

text.en: Basil Collier, The Defence of the United Kingdom (HMSO, 1957), ch. XVII and Appendix L: the German night offensive against British cities lasted from September 1940 to May 1941, ending with a big attack on London on 10 May and a raid on Birmingham on 16 May; civilian casualties in the United Kingdom from bombing during the whole war were 51,509 killed and 61,423 seriously injured; with flying bombs, rockets and cross-Channel guns, 60,595 killed.
text.zh: Basil Collier《保卫联合王国》（英国皇家文书局，1957）第十七章与附录 L：德国对英国城市的夜间轰炸从 1940 年 9 月持续到 1941 年 5 月，以 5 月 10 日对伦敦的大空袭和 5 月 16 日对伯明翰的空袭结束；整个战争期间英国平民被轰炸炸死 51,509 人，重伤 61,423 人；加上飞弹、火箭和跨海峡炮击，共死亡 60,595 人。

text.en: Karl-Heinz Frieser, The Blitzkrieg Legend: The 1940 Campaign in the West (German official history; English ed. Naval Institute Press, 2005): Panzer Group Kleist, which crossed the Ardennes, had about 134,370 men and 41,140 vehicles, including 1,222 tanks.
text.zh: Karl-Heinz Frieser《闪电战的传说：1940 年西线战役》（德国官方战史；英文版美国海军学会出版社，2005）：穿越阿登的克莱斯特装甲集群约有 134,370 人、41,140 辆车辆，其中坦克 1,222 辆。

note.en: Figures taken from the book as cited in the English Wikipedia article on the 1st Panzer Army; the page number was not checked against the book. Used only for the width of the route line.
note.zh: 数字取自英文维基百科“第 1 装甲集团军”条目对该书的引用，没有核对原书页码。只用于路线线宽。

text.en: George E. Blau, The German Campaign in Russia: Planning and Operations (1940–1942), Department of the Army Pamphlet 20-261a (1955), pp. 5, 38–41, 74, 88–89, 97: on 31 July 1940 Hitler decided that the Soviet Union should be attacked the following spring and defeated within five months, with the Ukraine, Belorussia and the Baltic States to come under German domination; for the invasion the Army had 145 divisions, including 19 armoured — Army Group North 30, Army Group Center 51, Army Group South 43 German and 14 Romanian divisions — and 3,050,000 men, 3,350 tanks, 7,184 guns and 625,000 horses; the Kiev pocket yielded 665,000 prisoners; German Army losses to 26 November 1941 were 743,112, including 156,475 killed, against 3,006,867 prisoners claimed; winter clothing had been ordered for only 60 divisions; temperatures fell as low as −50 °F.
text.zh: George E. Blau《德国对俄战役：计划与作战（1940–1942）》，美国陆军部第 20-261a 号小册子（1955），第 5、38–41、74、88–89、97 页：1940 年 7 月 31 日希特勒决定次年春进攻苏联、五个月内打垮，乌克兰、白俄罗斯和波罗的海国家归德国支配；入侵兵力 145 个师（含装甲师 19 个）——北方集团军群 30 个、中央集团军群 51 个、南方集团军群德军 43 个加罗马尼亚 14 个——共 305 万人、坦克 3,350 辆、火炮 7,184 门、马 62.5 万匹；基辅包围圈俘虏 66.5 万人；截至 1941 年 11 月 26 日德国陆军损失 743,112 人，其中阵亡 156,475 人，德方称俘虏 3,006,867 人；冬装只为 60 个师订购；气温低到华氏零下 50 度。

text.en: Earl F. Ziemke and Magna E. Bauer, Moscow to Stalingrad: Decision in the East (US Army Center of Military History, 1987): according to most Soviet accounts the western military districts had 2.9 million men on 22 June 1941; on 12 October 1941 Hitler ordered that Moscow, like Leningrad, be surrounded and starved rather than entered; the Soviet counteroffensive opened on 5–6 December, when temperatures near Moscow fell to −38 °F; besides the armies at the front, eight armies of about 800,000 men were still in the Stavka reserve.
text.zh: Earl F. Ziemke、Magna E. Bauer《从莫斯科到斯大林格勒：东线的决战》（美国陆军军事历史中心，1987）：据多数苏方记载，1941 年 6 月 22 日西部各军区共有 290 万人；1941 年 10 月 12 日希特勒下令对莫斯科像对列宁格勒一样包围、饿死，而不是进城；苏军反攻于 12 月 5–6 日开始，当时莫斯科附近气温降到华氏零下 38 度；除前线部队外，大本营预备队还有 8 个集团军、约 80 万人。

text.en: Transcript of the International Military Tribunal, Nuremberg, 19 February 1946 (Soviet prosecutor L. N. Smirnov), Harvard Law School Nuremberg Trials Project: 'as a result of the hunger blockade of Leningrad, 632,253 people perished'.
text.zh: 纽伦堡国际军事法庭 1946 年 2 月 19 日庭审记录（苏联公诉人斯米尔诺夫），哈佛法学院纽伦堡审判项目：“由于列宁格勒的饥饿封锁，632,253 人死亡”。

note.en: The Leningrad commission's figure; later research puts the toll higher [S78].
note.zh: 这是列宁格勒调查委员会的数字；后来的研究认为更高 [S78]。

text.en: Anna Reid, Leningrad: Tragedy of a City under Siege, 1941–44 (Bloomsbury, 2011), as excerpted in The History Reader: the total death toll in the city was somewhere between 700,000 and 800,000, one in every three or four of the pre-siege population, by January 1944.
text.zh: Anna Reid《列宁格勒：围城的悲剧 1941–44》（Bloomsbury，2011），The History Reader 摘录：到 1944 年 1 月，城内总死亡人数在 70 万到 80 万之间，相当于围城前人口的三分之一到四分之一。

text.en: The National WWII Museum (New Orleans), 'History Through the Viewfinder: The Siege of Leningrad': the siege lasted from 8 September 1941 to 27 January 1944, 872 days; about 1.5 million soldiers and civilians died.
text.zh: 美国国家二战博物馆（新奥尔良）《取景框里的历史：列宁格勒围城》：围城从 1941 年 9 月 8 日持续到 1944 年 1 月 27 日，共 872 天；军民约 150 万人死亡。

text.en: United States Holocaust Memorial Museum, Holocaust Encyclopedia, 'Mass Shootings at Babyn Yar (Babi Yar)': on 29–30 September 1941, according to reports sent to Einsatzgruppen headquarters in Berlin, 33,771 Jews were shot at the Babyn Yar ravine in Kyiv by Sonderkommando 4a of Einsatzgruppe C under Paul Blobel, with SS and German police units.
text.zh: 美国大屠杀纪念馆《大屠杀百科》“娘子谷大屠杀”：据送交柏林特别行动队总部的报告，1941 年 9 月 29 日至 30 日，特别行动队 C 队第 4a 特遣队（指挥官保罗·布洛贝尔）会同党卫队和德国警察部队，在基辅娘子谷峡谷枪杀了 33,771 名犹太人。

note.en: Checked through search-engine extracts (the museum's site timed out). Babi Yar remained a killing site for the rest of the occupation; Roma, Soviet prisoners of war and others were also killed there.
note.zh: 通过搜索引擎摘录核对（该馆网站访问超时）。整个占领期间娘子谷一直是屠杀地点，罗姆人、苏军战俘等也在那里被杀害。

text.en: United States Holocaust Memorial Museum, Holocaust Encyclopedia, 'Einsatzgruppen': members of these mobile killing units murdered well over one million civilians, mostly Jews, primarily in mass shootings in the occupied Soviet Union.
text.zh: 美国大屠杀纪念馆《大屠杀百科》“特别行动队”：这些流动屠杀部队杀害了远超 100 万名平民，主要是犹太人，大多是在被占领的苏联境内集体枪杀。

note.en: Checked through search-engine extracts (the museum's site timed out).
note.zh: 通过搜索引擎摘录核对（该馆网站访问超时）。

text.en: United States Holocaust Memorial Museum, Holocaust Encyclopedia, 'Nazi Persecution of Soviet Prisoners of War': some 5.7 million Soviet soldiers fell into German hands; 3.3 million of them, about 57 percent, were dead by the end of the war; after the Jews they were the largest group of victims of Nazi racial policy.
text.zh: 美国大屠杀纪念馆《大屠杀百科》“纳粹对苏军战俘的迫害”：约 570 万名苏军落入德军手中，到战争结束时其中 330 万人（约 57%）死亡；他们是仅次于犹太人的纳粹种族政策最大受害群体。

note.en: Checked through search-engine extracts (the museum's site timed out).
note.zh: 通过搜索引擎摘录核对（该馆网站访问超时）。

text.en: TASS, 23 January 2025, citing the Russian Ministry of Defence: irrecoverable Soviet losses in the war were 26.6 million people, including about 8.7 million military personnel.
text.zh: 塔斯社 2025 年 1 月 23 日援引俄罗斯国防部：苏联在战争中的不可挽回损失为 2,660 万人，其中军人约 870 万。

note.en: The 26.6 million figure comes from a 1990 demographic estimate (pre-war population minus post-war population, adjusted); Western estimates such as the National WWII Museum's 24 million [S14] are lower. Both are listed.
note.zh: 2,660 万这个数字来自 1990 年的人口学估算（战前人口减去战后人口再做修正）；西方的估计较低，如美国国家二战博物馆的 2,400 万 [S14]。两者并列。

text.en: Kirby, The War Against Japan, vol. I, pp. 70–71, 88: after Japanese troops moved into southern Indochina, the United States froze all Japanese assets on 26 July 1941, followed by Britain and the Netherlands East Indies; this cut off Japan's outside oil supplies — its own production met only about ten per cent of its needs and its reserves would last about three years of peace, much less in war; on 26 November 1941 the United States rejected Japan's last proposal and handed its envoys a note calling for, among other things, the evacuation of Japanese forces from China and Indochina.
text.zh: Kirby《对日战争》第一卷第 70–71、88 页：日军进驻印度支那南部后，美国于 1941 年 7 月 26 日冻结日本全部在美资产，英国和荷属东印度随后跟进；日本由此断了外来石油——本国产量只够需求的约一成，储备在和平时期约能维持三年，战时则短得多；1941 年 11 月 26 日，美国拒绝了日本的最后方案，并交给日本特使一份照会，其中要求日军撤出中国和印度支那。

text.en: Kirby, The War Against Japan, vol. I, pp. 97–99: the carrier striking force under Vice-Admiral Nagumo — four fleet carriers and two light fleet carriers, with two battleships, two cruisers, destroyers and eight tankers — assembled in Hitokappu Bay and sailed on 26 November 1941 on its 3,000-mile voyage; 360 aircraft were flown off on the morning of 7 December; the three US fleet carriers were not in harbour.
text.zh: Kirby《对日战争》第一卷第 97–99 页：南云中将指挥的航母打击部队——四艘舰队航母和两艘轻型舰队航母，另有两艘战列舰、两艘巡洋舰、驱逐舰和八艘油船——在单冠湾集结，1941 年 11 月 26 日出发，航程 3,000 英里；12 月 7 日早上共起飞 360 架飞机；美国三艘舰队航母当时都不在港内。

text.en: US House of Representatives, History, Art & Archives, 'The House declaration of war against Japan' (8 December 1941): the House adopted the war resolution immediately after Roosevelt's address; Jeannette Rankin's was the lone dissenting vote.
text.zh: 美国众议院历史档案办公室《众议院对日宣战》（1941 年 12 月 8 日）：罗斯福演说后众议院随即通过宣战决议，珍妮特·兰金投了唯一的反对票。

text.en: Foreign Relations of the United States, 1941, vol. I, doc. 587: the Joint Resolution of 11 December 1941 declaring a state of war with Germany, which 'has formally declared war against the Government and the people of the United States'; the same resolution, mutatis mutandis, was adopted for Italy.
text.zh: 《美国对外关系文件》1941 年第一卷第 587 号：1941 年 12 月 11 日宣布与德国处于战争状态的联合决议，理由是德国“已经正式对美国政府和人民宣战”；对意大利通过了内容相同的决议。

text.en: Louis Morton, The Fall of the Philippines (US Army in World War II, 1953), pp. 88, 125, 236, 455, 467: after the Japanese air attacks of 8 December the Far East Air Force had been cut in half (17 of 35 B-17s left); the 14th Army landing force at Lingayen Gulf on 22–28 December totalled 43,110 men; the Japanese entered Manila on 2 January 1942; General King, responsible for 78,000 men on Bataan, surrendered on 9 April 1942; the 65-mile 'death march' from Mariveles to San Fernando followed.
text.zh: Louis Morton《菲律宾的陷落》（美国陆军二战史，1953），第 88、125、236、455、467 页：12 月 8 日日军空袭后，远东航空队损失过半（35 架 B-17 只剩 17 架）；12 月 22 日至 28 日在林加延湾登陆的第 14 军共 43,110 人；日军 1942 年 1 月 2 日进入马尼拉；负责巴丹半岛 7.8 万人的金少将于 1942 年 4 月 9 日投降；随后是从马里韦莱斯到圣费尔南多 65 英里的“死亡行军”。

text.en: US National Archives, 'Executive Order 9066: Resulting in Japanese-American Incarceration (1942)': issued on 19 February 1942; in the following six months approximately 122,000 men, women and children were forcibly moved, then confined in 10 'relocation centers'; nearly 70,000 were American citizens; no charges were made against them; in 1988 Public Law 100-383 acknowledged the injustice, apologised, and paid $20,000 to each person who had been incarcerated.
text.zh: 美国国家档案馆《第 9066 号行政令：导致日裔美国人被监禁（1942）》：1942 年 2 月 19 日发布；此后六个月里约 12.2 万名男女老幼被强制迁移，再被关进 10 个“安置中心”；其中近 7 万人是美国公民；没有对他们提出任何指控；1988 年第 100-383 号公法承认这是不公正的，正式道歉，并向每位被监禁者赔偿 2 万美元。

text.en: Army Air Forces Statistical Digest, World War II (December 1945), Table 79: factory deliveries of all US military airplanes were 18,466 in 1941 and 96,270 in 1944; 295,959 from July 1940 to August 1945.
text.zh: 《陆军航空队统计摘要：第二次世界大战》（1945 年 12 月）表 79：美国各类军用飞机出厂交付量 1941 年 18,466 架，1944 年 96,270 架；1940 年 7 月至 1945 年 8 月共 295,959 架。

text.en: US Military Academy, Department of History, 'Campaign in Poland, 1939' (public domain; via Wikimedia Commons), with the maps in Kennedy, The German Campaign in Poland (maps 8–10). Route source for germany-poland-n, germany-poland-s and ussr-poland.
text.zh: 美国西点军校历史系地图《1939 年波兰战役》（公有领域，维基共享资源），并参照 Kennedy《德国对波兰的战役》的地图 8–10。德军南北两路和苏军入波路线的依据。

text.en: 'Eastern Front 1941-06 to 1941-12' (Gdr; CC BY-SA 3.0; via Wikimedia Commons), with the situation maps of 19 July, 30 July, mid-September, 6 October and 5 December 1941 in Blau, The German Campaign in Russia (maps 7–12). Route source for barbarossa-n, barbarossa-c and barbarossa-s.
text.zh: 《东线 1941 年 6 月至 12 月》（Gdr 绘，CC BY-SA 3.0，维基共享资源），并参照 Blau《德国对俄战役》中 1941 年 7 月 19 日、7 月 30 日、9 月中旬、10 月 6 日和 12 月 5 日的态势图（地图 7–12）。巴巴罗萨三路路线的依据。

text.en: US Army Center of Military History, 'Invasion of the Philippines, 1941' (map of Japanese landings and advances on Luzon, 8 December 1941 – 8 January 1942; public domain; via Wikimedia Commons), with Morton, The Fall of the Philippines, ch. VIII. Route source for japan-philippines.
text.zh: 美国陆军军事历史中心地图《1941 年入侵菲律宾》（1941 年 12 月 8 日至 1942 年 1 月 8 日日军在吕宋岛的登陆与推进；公有领域，维基共享资源），并参照 Morton《菲律宾的陷落》第八章。日军入菲路线的依据。

text.en: Goh Sin Tub, 'The Sook Ching', BiblioAsia 12(4), Jan–Mar 2017 (National Library Board, Singapore): the operation 'slaughtered possibly up to 50,000 Singapore people'; note 2: 'the official estimates given by the Japanese is 5,000 but the actual number is believed to be 8−10 times higher'.
text.zh: 吴新德《肃清》，《BiblioAsia》第 12 卷第 4 期（2017 年 1–3 月，新加坡国家图书馆管理局）：这次行动“可能屠杀了多达 5 万名新加坡人”；注 2：“日方给出的官方估计是 5,000 人，但实际人数相信高出 8 至 10 倍”。

text.en: Lim Tin Seng, 'From Exclusive to Inclusive Remembrance: The Civilian War Memorial', BiblioAsia 7(2), Jul 2011 (National Library Board): 'The Japanese put the figure at about 5,000, while the Chinese estimated it to be around 100,000. But it has been widely assumed that the number of victims was between 25,000 and 50,000.' After the operation the Chinese community had to raise $50 million as 'tribute money'. In February 1962 a mass grave was unearthed at Siglap; the Singapore Chinese Chamber of Commerce searched for others and demanded a 'blood debt' from Japan. The Civilian War Memorial was unveiled on 15 February 1967, and a commemorative service is held there every 15 February.
text.zh: 林振胜《从排他到包容的纪念：日据时期死难人民纪念碑》，《BiblioAsia》第 7 卷第 2 期（2011 年 7 月，新加坡国家图书馆管理局）：“日方估计约 5,000 人，华人估计约 10 万人。但一般认为遇难者在 25,000 至 50,000 人之间。”行动之后，华人社会被迫筹集 5,000 万元“奉纳金”。1962 年 2 月实里达（Siglap）发现集体坟场；中华总商会寻找其他坟场，并向日本要求偿还“血债”。纪念碑于 1967 年 2 月 15 日揭幕，此后每年 2 月 15 日在碑前举行纪念仪式。

text.en: Wai Keng Kwok, Justice Done? Criminal and Moral Responsibility Issues in the Chinese Massacres Trial, Singapore, 1947 (Yale University Genocide Studies Program, Working Paper 18, 2001): Chinese 'males aged eighteen to fifty should present themselves for inspection'; 'officially, the "Chinese Massacres" Trial of March 1947 puts the number at around five thousand but unofficially … as high as fifty thousand'.
text.zh: Wai Keng Kwok《正义得到伸张了吗？1947 年新加坡“华侨大屠杀”审判中的刑事与道德责任问题》（耶鲁大学种族灭绝研究项目工作论文第 18 号，2001）：“18 岁至 50 岁的华人男子须前往接受检查”；“1947 年 3 月的‘华侨大屠杀’审判官方认定的人数约为 5,000，但非官方的估计……高达 5 万”。

text.en: Hayashi Hirofumi (Kanto Gakuin University), 'Massacre of Chinese in Singapore and its Coverage in Postwar Japan': mass screening was carried out mainly by Kempeitai personnel between 21 and 23 February 1942 in the urban areas and by the Imperial Guard Division at the end of February in the suburbs; those picked out were taken to the coast and machine-gunned. The diary of the Kempeitai commander Kawamura Saburō gives 5,000 killed; a 25th Army intelligence record of 28 May 1942 gives 11,110 'missing as a result of bombing and the purge'.
text.zh: 林博史（关东学院大学）《新加坡华侨大屠杀及其在战后日本的报道》：大检证在市区主要由宪兵队于 1942 年 2 月 21 日至 23 日进行，郊区由近卫师团在 2 月底进行；被挑出的人被押到海边用机枪扫射。宪兵队指挥官河村参郎的日记记为 5,000 人；第 25 军 1942 年 5 月 28 日的情报记录记为“因轰炸和肃清而失踪”11,110 人。

note.en: Hayashi notes that the credibility of the 11,110 figure is open to question; he regards the real number as considerably higher than the Japanese records.
note.zh: 林博史指出 11,110 这个数字的可信度存疑；日方记录普遍低于实际人数。

text.en: Roots.sg (National Heritage Board), historic site marker 'Changi Beach Massacre': 66 Chinese male civilians were killed by Japanese hojo kempei (auxiliary military police) firing squads at the water's edge on Changi Beach on 20 February 1942, during the Sook Ching operation (18 February – 4 March 1942).
text.zh: Roots.sg（新加坡国家文物局）史迹标志“樟宜海滩屠杀”：1942 年 2 月 20 日，66 名华人男性平民在樟宜海滩水边被日本辅助宪兵行刑队枪杀；这是肃清行动（1942 年 2 月 18 日至 3 月 4 日）的一部分。

text.en: Roots.sg (National Heritage Board), historic site marker 'Punggol Beach Massacre': on 28 February 1942 some 400 Chinese civilians, victims of the Sook Ching purge, were killed by the Japanese on this north-eastern shore.
text.zh: Roots.sg（新加坡国家文物局）史迹标志“榜鹅海滩屠杀”：1942 年 2 月 28 日，约 400 名华人平民在这片东北海岸被日军杀害，他们是肃清行动的受害者。

text.en: SG101 (Government of Singapore), 'Punggol Beach: an Operation Sook Ching site': from 21 February to 4 March 1942 Chinese males between the ages of 18 and 50 were summoned to mass screening centres; those identified as anti-Japanese were taken away and killed.
text.zh: SG101（新加坡政府）《榜鹅海滩：肃清行动地点》：1942 年 2 月 21 日至 3 月 4 日，18 至 50 岁的华人男子被召集到各大检证中心；被认定为“抗日分子”的人被带走杀害。

text.en: Lee Geok Boi, 'Wartime Victuals: Surviving the Japanese Occupation', BiblioAsia 15(1), Apr–Jun 2019 (National Library Board): the population of Syonan was around 900,000 in 1943; the rice ration started at 20 katis (about 12 kg) a month per person, dropping to 8 katis for men, 6 for women and 4 per child; people switched to tapioca and sweet potatoes; 'banana money' became worthless through runaway inflation — an egg cost 3 cents before the war and $100 at the end of the occupation, a kati of pork 30 cents and then $1,500; between 1942 and 1945 recorded deaths more than doubled, from 29,831 to 65,158.
text.zh: 李玉美《战时饮食：在日据时期活下来》，《BiblioAsia》第 15 卷第 1 期（2019 年 4–6 月，新加坡国家图书馆管理局）：1943 年昭南人口约 90 万；大米配给起初每人每月 20 斤（约 12 公斤），后来降到男子 8 斤、女子 6 斤、儿童 4 斤；人们改吃木薯和番薯；“香蕉钱”因通货膨胀失去价值——战前一个鸡蛋 3 分钱，占领末期 100 元，一斤猪肉从 3 角涨到 1,500 元；1942 至 1945 年间登记死亡人数增加一倍多，从 29,831 人增至 65,158 人。

note.en: The prices come from the oral history of the businessman Chua Eng Cheow (National Archives of Singapore). A kati is about 600 g.
note.zh: 物价出自商人蔡荣祥的口述历史（新加坡国家档案馆）。1 斤约 600 克。

text.en: Australian War Memorial, 'F Force on the Burma–Thailand Railway': working parties of prisoners had begun work on the railway by June 1942; the 415 km of rail between Thanbyuzayat and Nong Pladuk were joined on 17 October 1943 at Konkoita; F Force's trains travelled north from Singapore for five days to Ban Pong; 'of the 62,000 Allied prisoners of war used on the Burma–Thailand Railway, 11,979 died'; 87,000 prisoners rotated through Changi during the war.
text.zh: 澳大利亚战争纪念馆《泰缅铁路上的 F 部队》：到 1942 年 6 月已有战俘工作队开始修路；泰国丹彪扎亚至农布拉杜克之间 415 公里的铁路于 1943 年 10 月 17 日在 Konkoita 接通；F 部队的列车从新加坡北上五天到达班蓬；“修建泰缅铁路的 62,000 名盟军战俘中，11,979 人死亡”；战争期间先后有 87,000 名战俘经过樟宜。

text.en: Australian War Memorial, 'Stolen Years: Australian prisoners of war — The Burma–Thailand Railway': the railway was built by about 60,000 Allied prisoners of war and 200,000 romusha (Asian labourers); by its completion in October 1943 at least 2,815 Australians, over 11,000 other Allied prisoners and perhaps 75,000 romusha were dead.
text.zh: 澳大利亚战争纪念馆《被偷走的岁月：澳大利亚战俘——泰缅铁路》：铁路由约 6 万名盟军战俘和 20 万名亚洲劳工（romusha）修建；到 1943 年 10 月完工时，至少 2,815 名澳大利亚人、11,000 多名其他盟军战俘和大约 75,000 名亚洲劳工已经死亡。

text.en: Australian Government, Department of Veterans' Affairs, Anzac Portal, 'Rōmusha on the railway': up to 90,000 rōmusha died on the Burma–Thailand Railway; most have no marked graves, and a memorial honours some 90,000 Asian labourers.
text.zh: 澳大利亚政府退伍军人事务部 Anzac Portal《铁路上的劳务者》：泰缅铁路上死亡的亚洲劳工多达 9 万人；他们大多没有标明的坟墓，一座纪念碑纪念约 9 万名亚洲劳工。

note.en: The portal did not respond to automated access; the figure was checked through search-engine extracts of its pages. No count was kept of the labourers, so all figures are estimates; the Australian War Memorial gives 'perhaps 75,000' [S103]. Both are listed.
note.zh: 该网站拒绝自动访问；数字通过搜索引擎对其页面的摘录核对。当年没有人统计劳工人数，所以都是估计；澳大利亚战争纪念馆的说法是“大约 75,000”[S103]。两者并列。

text.en: Australian High Commission, Singapore, 'Operation Jaywick' (2013): on 26 September 1943 fourteen Australian and British commandos in canoes sank or damaged about 37,000 tonnes of shipping in Singapore harbour; on 10 October 1943 (the 'Double Tenth') the Kempeitai took away 57 civilian internees from Changi Gaol for interrogation, and fifteen of them died during interrogation; the later round-up included Choy Khun Heng and Elizabeth Choy.
text.zh: 澳大利亚驻新加坡高级专员公署《杰威克行动》（2013）：1943 年 9 月 26 日，14 名澳大利亚和英国突击队员乘独木舟潜入新加坡港，击沉或炸伤约 37,000 吨船只；1943 年 10 月 10 日（“双十”）宪兵队从樟宜监狱带走 57 名被拘留的平民审讯，其中 15 人在审讯中死亡；随后的大搜捕中还有蔡坤兴和伊丽莎白·蔡（蔡秀美）。

text.en: Roots.sg (National Heritage Board), 'Changi Prison Gate Wall and Turrets' (National Monument): on 17 February 1942 European civilians were marched to Changi, and more than 2,500 civilians and POWs, including the entire British civil service, were packed into the prison; ill-treatment of internees worsened after the 'Double Tenth Incident' of 10 October 1943, when the Kempeitai raided the cells after Operation Jaywick.
text.zh: Roots.sg（新加坡国家文物局）“樟宜监狱大门、围墙和塔楼”（国家古迹）：1942 年 2 月 17 日欧洲平民被押往樟宜，2,500 多名平民和战俘（包括整个英国公务员系统）被塞进这座监狱；1943 年 10 月 10 日“双十事件”中宪兵队因杰威克行动搜查牢房，此后被拘留者的处境更加恶劣。

text.en: Roots.sg (National Heritage Board), story 'Lim Bo Seng' and the Force 136 historic marker: Lim Bo Seng (27 April 1909 – 29 June 1944) escaped to India and joined Force 136, recruiting Chinese agents to gather intelligence in Malaya; after the network was betrayed he was arrested, starved and tortured by the Japanese military police at Batu Gajah Gaol (Perak), where he died aged 35; after the war he was buried with military honours at MacRitchie Reservoir. Force 136 was part of Britain's Special Operations Executive (SOE), headquartered in Kandy, Ceylon; it recruited local Chinese and Malays and landed agents in Malaya by submarine.
text.zh: Roots.sg（新加坡国家文物局）故事“林谋盛”与“136 部队”史迹标志：林谋盛（1909 年 4 月 27 日—1944 年 6 月 29 日）逃到印度，加入 136 部队，招募华人特工到马来亚搜集情报；情报网遭出卖后他被捕，在霹雳州华都牙也（Batu Gajah）监狱被日本宪兵饿饭、拷打，死时 35 岁；战后以军礼葬于麦里芝蓄水池。136 部队属于英国特别行动处（SOE），总部设在锡兰康提，招募本地华人和马来人，用潜艇把特工送进马来亚。

text.en: 'Women and Warfare in Malaysia and Singapore, 1941–1989', BiblioAsia 6(1), Apr 2010 (National Library Board): the Malayan People's Anti-Japanese Army (MPAJA) was the armed force of the Malayan Communist Party; Chinese women served it as couriers and fighters; Force 136 officers lived with the guerrillas as liaison officers; Elizabeth Choy and Sybil Kathigasu helped the resistance from outside the jungle.
text.zh: 《BiblioAsia》第 6 卷第 1 期（2010 年 4 月，新加坡国家图书馆管理局）《马来西亚与新加坡的妇女与战争，1941–1989》：马来亚人民抗日军是马来亚共产党的武装；华人妇女为它当交通员、也拿枪作战；136 部队的军官作为联络官和游击队生活在一起；伊丽莎白·蔡和 Sybil Kathigasu 在丛林外帮助抵抗运动。

text.en: Singapore Council of Women's Organisations, Singapore Women's Hall of Fame, 'Elizabeth Choy': she and her husband ran a canteen at what is now Woodbridge Hospital and secretly carried food, medicine, money, letters and radios to British prisoners of war; arrested in 1943, she was held for 193 days and repeatedly tortured, including with electric shocks; after returning to Singapore in 1949 she became the first and only woman member of the Legislative Council, and left politics in 1955 to teach.
text.zh: 新加坡妇女组织理事会“新加坡女性名人堂”《伊丽莎白·蔡》：她和丈夫在今天的板桥医院经营食堂，暗中给英国战俘送食物、药品、钱、信件和收音机；1943 年被捕，被关押 193 天，多次受酷刑，包括电击；1949 年回到新加坡后，成为立法议会第一位、也是唯一一位女议员，1955 年离开政坛去教书。

text.en: Roots.sg (National Museum of Singapore collection), 'Painting of locals learning Japanese in schools': in Japanese schools such as the Syonan Nippon Gakuen in Queen Street pupils learned to speak and write Japanese, sang the Japanese national anthem and bowed before the picture of the Emperor before the day began; families who refused to send their children received smaller food rations, and those who excelled in Japanese got an extra allowance.
text.zh: Roots.sg（新加坡国家博物馆藏品）《本地人在学校学日语的画》：在昭南日本学园（位于桥北路）等日语学校，学生学习说写日语，每天上课前唱日本国歌、向天皇像鞠躬；不送孩子上学的家庭配给减少，日语学得好的有额外津贴。

text.en: Roots.sg (National Heritage Board), 'Syonan Jinja' historic site: after the surrender Singapore was renamed Syonan-to ('Light of the South').
text.zh: Roots.sg（新加坡国家文物局）“昭南神社”史迹：投降后新加坡被改名为“昭南岛”（意为“南方之光”）。

text.en: Roots.sg (National Heritage Board), historic site 'Kempeitai East District Branch': the former YMCA building on Stamford Road was the headquarters of the Kempeitai's East District Branch under Lieutenant-Colonel Oishi Masayuki, with about 200 regular Kempeitai and 1,000 auxiliaries; suspects were held and tortured there, among them Elizabeth Choy and her husband, arrested in October 1943; the building was pulled down in 1981.
text.zh: Roots.sg（新加坡国家文物局）史迹“宪兵队东区分队”：史丹福路的旧基督教青年会（YMCA）大楼是大石正幸中佐指挥的宪兵队东区分队总部，有正规宪兵约 200 人、辅助宪兵 1,000 人；嫌疑人被关押在这里并遭拷打，其中有 1943 年 10 月被捕的伊丽莎白·蔡和她的丈夫；大楼于 1981 年拆除。

text.en: Roots.sg (National Heritage Board), 'Former Ford Factory' (National Monument): Percival met Yamashita at the factory on 15 February 1942 and that evening signed the unconditional surrender in its boardroom; during the occupation Nissan used the plant to assemble military vehicles.
text.zh: Roots.sg（新加坡国家文物局）“旧福特车厂”（国家古迹）：1942 年 2 月 15 日白思华在车厂与山下奉文会面，当晚在会议室签署无条件投降书；日据时期日产公司用这座工厂组装军用车辆。

text.en: Roots.sg (National Heritage Board), 'Former City Hall' (National Monument): in the Municipal Building, Admiral Lord Louis Mountbatten, Supreme Allied Commander South East Asia, accepted the surrender from General Itagaki Seishirō on 12 September 1945, followed by a victory parade on the Padang; in 1959 Lee Kuan Yew and his ministers were sworn in there, and on 16 September 1963 he read the Proclamation of Malaysia from its steps.
text.zh: Roots.sg（新加坡国家文物局）“旧市政厅”（国家古迹）：1945 年 9 月 12 日，东南亚盟军最高统帅蒙巴顿海军上将在市政大厦接受板垣征四郎大将投降，随后在大草场举行胜利游行；1959 年李光耀和他的部长们在这里宣誓就职，1963 年 9 月 16 日他在大厦台阶上宣读马来西亚成立宣言。

text.en: Timothy Pwee, 'A War Crimes Trial Snapshot', BiblioAsia, 1 January 2016 (National Library Board): 131 war-crimes trials were held in Singapore between 21 January 1946 and 12 March 1948; the 'Double Tenth' trial (18 March – 15 April 1946) involved 21 Japanese soldiers and interpreters accused of torturing and killing internees of Changi Prison, where the Kempeitai had raided on 10 October 1943 and found a wireless set, after which 57 internees were tortured and interrogated over several months and 15 died; the main Sook Ching trial, at the Victoria Memorial Hall from 10 March to 2 April 1947, found all seven accused officers guilty — Lieutenant-General Kawamura Saburō and Lieutenant-Colonel Oishi Masayuki were sentenced to death and the other five to life imprisonment; the figure most often quoted for the Sook Ching comes from an affidavit by Lieutenant-Colonel Hishakari Takafumi, then a newspaper correspondent, that the plan was to kill 50,000 Chinese and half that number had been reached when the order came to stop.
text.zh: Timothy Pwee《战犯审判掠影》，《BiblioAsia》2016 年 1 月 1 日（新加坡国家图书馆管理局）：1946 年 1 月 21 日至 1948 年 3 月 12 日，新加坡共举行 131 场战犯审判；“双十”审判（1946 年 3 月 18 日至 4 月 15 日）的被告是 21 名日本军人和翻译，罪名是拷打和杀害樟宜监狱的被拘留者——1943 年 10 月 10 日宪兵队搜查监狱、搜出一台无线电，此后 57 名被拘留者在几个月里受到拷打审讯，15 人死亡；肃清案的主审判 1947 年 3 月 10 日至 4 月 2 日在维多利亚纪念堂举行，七名被告军官全部有罪，河村参郎中将和大石正幸中佐被判死刑，其余五人终身监禁；关于肃清人数，最常被引用的是当时任报社记者的Hishakari Takafumi 中佐的宣誓书：计划杀 5 万名华人，杀到一半时接到停止的命令。

text.en: The National WWII Museum (New Orleans), 'The Battle of Midway': Japan lost the carriers Akagi, Kaga, Soryu and Hiryu, a cruiser, hundreds of aircraft and approximately 3,057 men; the United States lost the carrier Yorktown (sunk by a Japanese submarine on 7 June), a destroyer, 144 aircraft and about 362 men; codebreakers of Station Hypo gave the date and order of battle, after Midway sent out a false message that it was short of fresh water and Japanese signals then reported 'AF' short of water.
text.zh: 美国国家二战博物馆（新奥尔良）《中途岛海战》：日本损失赤城、加贺、苍龙、飞龙四艘航母、一艘巡洋舰、数百架飞机和约 3,057 人；美国损失约克城号航母（6 月 7 日被日本潜艇击沉）、一艘驱逐舰、144 架飞机和约 362 人；中途岛故意发出淡水短缺的假电报，随后日方电报报告“AF”缺水，夏威夷的“Hypo 站”密码破译员由此确认目标，并提供了日期和日军兵力部署。

text.en: John Miller Jr., Guadalcanal: The First Offensive (US Army in World War II, Washington, 1949), pp. 71, 81, 350: by 8 p.m. on 7 August 1942 about 10,000 troops had come ashore on Guadalcanal (the whole landing force, with Tulagi, was over 19,000); in all about 60,000 US Army and Marine ground troops served on the island, of whom about 1,600 were killed and 4,245 wounded; of more than 36,000 Japanese who fought there, over 14,800 were killed or missing, 9,000 died of disease and about 1,000 were taken prisoner.
text.zh: John Miller Jr.，《瓜达尔卡纳尔：第一次攻势》（美国陆军二战史，华盛顿，1949）第 71、81、350 页：1942 年 8 月 7 日晚 8 时约 1 万人登上瓜岛（连同图拉吉岛整个登陆部队超过 1.9 万人）；先后约 6 万名美国陆军和海军陆战队地面部队在岛上作战，约 1,600 人阵亡、4,245 人负伤；在岛上作战的 3.6 万多名日军中，1.48 万多人阵亡或失踪，9,000 人病死，约 1,000 人被俘。

note.en: Ground forces only; US naval and air losses around the island are not included.
note.zh: 只计地面部队，不含美军在岛屿周边的海军和航空兵损失。

text.en: I. S. O. Playfair and others, The Mediterranean and Middle East, vol. IV: The Destruction of the Axis Forces in Africa (HMSO, 1966), pp. 9, 78–79: the fighting strength of the Eighth Army was about 195,000 against about 50,000 Germans and 54,000 Italians; it had 1,029 tanks fit for action; the battle of El Alamein 'may be said to have ended at dawn on 4th November'; Eighth Army casualties were about 13,560 (2,350 killed, 8,950 wounded, 2,260 missing); by 11 November about 30,000 Axis prisoners had been taken (7,802 German and 22,071 Italian).
text.zh: I. S. O. Playfair 等，《地中海与中东》第四卷《轴心国在非洲的覆灭》（英国皇家文书局，1966）第 9、78–79 页：第 8 集团军战斗兵力约 19.5 万人，对面是约 5 万德军和 5.4 万意军；第 8 集团军有可用坦克 1,029 辆；阿拉曼战役“可以说在 11 月 4 日拂晓结束”；第 8 集团军伤亡约 13,560 人（阵亡 2,350、负伤 8,950、失踪 2,260）；到 11 月 11 日共俘虏轴心国军队约 3 万人（德军 7,802、意军 22,071）。

text.en: George F. Howe, Northwest Africa: Seizing the Initiative in the West (US Army in World War II, Washington, 1957), ch. III, IX, XXXIV: three task forces landed on 8 November 1942 — Western (Casablanca area, eventually 33,843 men, sailing from the United States), Center (Oran, planned at about 37,100 Americans and 3,600 British) and Eastern (Algiers, 45,000 British and 10,000 American troops planned in the area by 12 November), both sailing from Britain; on 10 November Admiral Darlan ordered the French forces in Pétain's name to stop fighting, and Casablanca surrendered on 11 November; the last week of fighting in Tunisia, ending on 13 May 1943, brought about 275,000 prisoners into Allied custody.
text.zh: George F. Howe，《西北非：在西线夺取主动》（美国陆军二战史，华盛顿，1957）第三、九、三十四章：1942 年 11 月 8 日三支特遣舰队登陆——西路（卡萨布兰卡一带，最终 33,843 人，从美国出发）、中路（奥兰，计划约 37,100 名美军和 3,600 名英军）和东路（阿尔及尔，计划到 11 月 12 日在当地集结英军 4.5 万、美军 1 万），后两路从英国出发；11 月 10 日达尔朗海军上将以贝当的名义命令法军停火，卡萨布兰卡 11 月 11 日投降；突尼斯的战斗 1943 年 5 月 13 日结束，最后一周盟军俘虏约 27.5 万人。

text.en: The National WWII Museum, 'Operation Torch': over 600 ships and 100,000 Allied troops took part in the landings in French North Africa; the campaign ended in Tunisia in May 1943, forcing a quarter of a million German and Italian soldiers to surrender.
text.zh: 美国国家二战博物馆《火炬行动》：600 多艘舰船和 10 万盟军参加了在法属北非的登陆；战役 1943 年 5 月在突尼斯结束，约 25 万德意军队投降。

text.en: Earl F. Ziemke, Stalingrad to Berlin: The German Defeat in the East (US Army Center of Military History, 1968), ch. III–IV: the Romanian Third Army took over the Don front west of Stalingrad; the Soviet counter-offensive of 19 November 1942 committed about 1,000,000 men, with much greater superiority in the crucial sectors; in the Stalingrad pocket the Germans lost somewhat over 200,000 men; Soviet figures set German casualties at 147,000 killed and wounded and over 91,000 captured, including 24 generals; the Soviet Union did not publish its own losses.
text.zh: Earl F. Ziemke，《从斯大林格勒到柏林：德国在东线的失败》（美国陆军军事历史中心，1968）第三、四章：罗马尼亚第 3 集团军接防斯大林格勒以西的顿河防线；1942 年 11 月 19 日苏军反攻投入约 100 万人，在关键地段的优势更大；德军在斯大林格勒包围圈中损失 20 万多人；苏方数字称德军阵亡和负伤 14.7 万人、被俘 9.1 万多人，其中将军 24 名；苏联没有公布自己的损失。

text.en: Antony Beevor, Stalingrad (Viking, 1998), p. 198 and Appendix B: Sixth Army's ration strength implies that almost 290,000 men were surrounded on 22 November 1942; the defence of 'Pavlov's house' by a platoon of the 42nd Guards Regiment lasted fifty-eight days; the Red Army's losses in the campaign were 1.1 million casualties, of which 485,751 were fatal; of the 91,000 prisoners almost half had died by the spring, and only about 5,000 returned home.
text.zh: 安东尼·比弗，《斯大林格勒》（Viking，1998）第 198 页及附录 B：按第 6 集团军的口粮人数推算，1942 年 11 月 22 日被包围的约有 29 万人；近卫第 42 团一个排守卫“巴甫洛夫大楼”，坚持了 58 天；红军在整个战役中伤亡 110 万人，其中死亡 485,751 人；9.1 万名俘虏到第二年春天已死去将近一半，最后只有约 5,000 人回到家乡。

note.en: Vasily Chuikov, who commanded the 62nd Army in the city, wrote that the house was held 'for more than fifty days' (The Battle for Stalingrad, 1964). Who led the defence is also told two ways: Sergeant Yakov Pavlov took command after Lieutenant Afanasyev was wounded.
note.zh: 在城中指挥第 62 集团军的崔可夫写的是“守了五十多天”（《斯大林格勒之战》，1964）。由谁指挥守楼也有两种说法：阿法纳西耶夫中尉受伤后由雅科夫·巴甫洛夫中士接替。

text.en: The National WWII Museum, 'History Through the Viewfinder: Stalingrad': Operation Uranus began on 19 November 1942; the last German resistance in the city ended on 2 February 1943; of the Sixth Army men taken prisoner, only 5,000 would live to return to Germany in the decade after the war.
text.zh: 美国国家二战博物馆《镜头里的历史：斯大林格勒》：“天王星行动”1942 年 11 月 19 日开始；城内德军最后的抵抗在 1943 年 2 月 2 日结束；第 6 集团军的俘虏中，只有 5,000 人在战后十年里活着回到德国。

text.en: Keith Huxen, 'History Through the Viewfinder: Kursk', The National WWII Museum, 31 August 2018: Germany attacked on 5 July 1943 with more than 780,000 troops and nearly 3,000 tanks against more than 1.9 million Soviet troops with more than 5,000 tanks; it was the last major offensive Germany was able to launch on the Eastern Front; the Soviet counter-offensive took Kharkov on 23 August.
text.zh: Keith Huxen《镜头里的历史：库尔斯克》，美国国家二战博物馆，2018 年 8 月 31 日：1943 年 7 月 5 日德国以 78 万多人、近 3,000 辆坦克发起进攻，对面是 190 多万苏军和 5,000 多辆坦克；这是德国在东线能发动的最后一次大攻势；苏军反攻在 8 月 23 日夺回哈尔科夫。

note.en: Other estimates of the forces differ (some give about 900,000 Germans); these are the museum's figures.
note.zh: 兵力的其他估计不一（有的说德军约 90 万人）；这里用的是该馆的数字。

text.en: Wesley F. Craven and James L. Cate (eds.), The Army Air Forces in World War II, vol. VII: Services Around the World (University of Chicago Press, 1958), ch. 4 'Airline to China': 'a grand total of some 650,000 tons of gasoline, munitions, other commodities, and men traveled the air route over the Hump' from India to China between 1942 and November 1945.
text.zh: Wesley F. Craven、James L. Cate 主编，《二战中的美国陆军航空队》第七卷《遍布全球的勤务》（芝加哥大学出版社，1958）第四章“通往中国的航线”：1942 年至 1945 年 11 月，经“驼峰”从印度飞往中国的汽油、弹药、其他物资和人员“总计约 65 万吨”。

text.en: Xinhua News Agency, 'Peng Shiliang: fighting Japan, giving his life for the country', 28 July 2025: the Japanese offensive against the Chinese line at Changde and Taoyuan began on 2 November 1943; Major-General Peng Shiliang, the first general killed in the Changde campaign, fell covering the withdrawal from Shimen on 15 November; the article reports Japanese use of poison gas in the fighting of 14 November.
text.zh: 新华社《彭士量：英勇抗日 以身许国》，2025 年 7 月 28 日：1943 年 11 月 2 日日军向常德、桃源一线中国军队发动进攻，常德会战开始；暂编第 5 师师长彭士量少将 11 月 15 日在掩护部队撤出石门时阵亡，是常德会战中牺牲的第一位将军；文章记述日军在 11 月 14 日的战斗中使用了毒气。

note.en: The poison-gas reports come from the Chinese Sixth War Area's report of 26 December 1943, which counted 74 uses of gas in the campaign (as cited by Guancha, 'This day in the War of Resistance: 26 December', 2025).
note.zh: 毒气的说法出自第六战区司令长官部 1943 年 12 月 26 日的《常德会战战斗要报》，其中统计日军在会战中使用毒气 74 次（据观察者网《抗战史上的今天：12 月 26 日》，2025）。

text.en: Hu Bo, 'Famous generals of the War of Resistance', The Paper (Shanghai), 9 December 2016: the Chinese 57th Division held Changde against the Japanese 116th Division for eleven days from 23 November 1943; the city fell on the morning of 3 December and was retaken six days later; according to the division's battle report, 8,529 of its officers and men fought and 7,869 were killed or wounded.
text.zh: 胡博《抗战名将︱为何拒降的将领有罪，投降的将领反而有功？》，澎湃新闻，2016 年 12 月 9 日：1943 年 11 月 23 日起，第 57 师在常德抵抗日军第 116 师团 11 天；12 月 3 日上午城陷，六天后被收复；据第 57 师战报，全师参战官兵 8,529 人，伤亡 7,869 人。

text.en: US Military Academy, Department of History, 'Battle of Midway' (public domain; via Wikimedia Commons): approach routes of the Japanese carrier striking force from Japan and of US Task Forces 16 and 17 from Pearl Harbor to their positions north-east of Midway.
text.zh: 美国西点军校历史系《中途岛海战》地图（公有领域，维基共享资源）：日本航母机动部队从日本出发、美军第 16 和第 17 特混舰队从珍珠港出发，到达中途岛东北阵位的航线。

text.en: US Army Center of Military History, 'Operation Torch' overview map (public domain; via Wikimedia Commons): landing areas of the Western Task Force (Safi, Fedala, Mehdia), Center Task Force (Oran) and Eastern Task Force (Algiers), 8 November 1942.
text.zh: 美国陆军军事历史中心《火炬行动》总图（公有领域，维基共享资源）：1942 年 11 月 8 日西路（萨菲、费达拉、迈赫迪耶）、中路（奥兰）和东路（阿尔及尔）特遣舰队的登陆区域。

text.en: US Military Academy, Department of History, 'German summer offensive, 24 July – 18 November 1942' and 'Soviet winter offensive, 13 December 1942 – 18 February 1943' (public domain; via Wikimedia Commons): the Don and Stalingrad fronts on the eve of the Soviet counter-offensive and after the encirclement.
text.zh: 美国西点军校历史系《德军夏季攻势，1942 年 7 月 24 日—11 月 18 日》和《苏军冬季攻势，1942 年 12 月 13 日—1943 年 2 月 18 日》地图（公有领域，维基共享资源）：苏军反攻前夕和合围之后的顿河—斯大林格勒战线。

text.en: Marc Laurenceau, 'D-Day figures', dday-overlord.com: 156,115 Allied soldiers and paratroopers engaged in Normandy on 6 June 1944, of whom 132,000 landed from the sea; about 10,500 Allied casualties (killed, wounded, missing and prisoners) by midnight; German losses on 6 June estimated at about 10,000.
text.zh: Marc Laurenceau《诺曼底登陆日数字》，dday-overlord.com：1944 年 6 月 6 日共有 156,115 名盟军士兵和伞兵投入诺曼底，其中 13.2 万人从海上登陆；到午夜盟军伤亡（阵亡、负伤、失踪、被俘）约 10,500 人；德军当天的损失估计约 1 万人。

note.en: The National WWII Museum gives 'nearly 160,000'. Casualty figures for the day are estimates on both sides.
note.zh: 美国国家二战博物馆的说法是“近 16 万”。双方当天的伤亡数字都是估计。

text.en: Imperial War Museums, 'Operation Fortitude: D-Day's deception strategy', and MI5, 'Agent GARBO': Fortitude South invented a First US Army Group (FUSAG) of 11 non-existent divisions (150,000 men) in south-east England under General Patton, with fake radio traffic, inflatable tanks and dummy landing craft, to suggest a landing in the Pas de Calais; the double agent Juan Pujol (GARBO), with a network of 24 invented sub-agents, told the Germans that Normandy was a diversion, and German armoured and infantry divisions were kept waiting in the Pas de Calais.
text.zh: 英国帝国战争博物馆《坚忍行动：诺曼底的欺敌战略》与英国军情五处《特工 GARBO》：“南方坚忍”在英格兰东南部虚构了一个由巴顿指挥的“美国第一集团军群”，号称 11 个师、15 万人，用假无线电通信、充气坦克和假登陆艇，让德军以为登陆点在加来海峡；双面间谍胡安·普霍尔（代号 GARBO）编造了 24 名下线，向德方报告诺曼底只是佯攻，德军的装甲师和步兵师因此留在加来海峡等候。

note.en: Both sites refused automated access; the text was checked through search-engine extracts of the two pages (MI5: https://www.mi5.gov.uk/history/world-war-ii/agent-garbo).
note.zh: 两个网站都拒绝自动访问；内容通过搜索引擎对两页的摘录核对（军情五处：https://www.mi5.gov.uk/history/world-war-ii/agent-garbo）。

text.en: The National WWII Museum, 'The Liberation of Paris': the French 2nd Armored Division under General Leclerc entered Paris on the morning of 25 August 1944, with the US 4th Infantry Division in support and French resistance fighters and police fighting in the streets; the German commander, General von Choltitz, with a garrison of about 20,000, was captured and signed the surrender at 3 p.m.
text.zh: 美国国家二战博物馆《巴黎解放》：1944 年 8 月 25 日上午，勒克莱尔将军的法国第 2 装甲师进入巴黎，美军第 4 步兵师策应，法国抵抗力量和警察在街头作战；德军指挥官肖尔蒂茨将军（守军约 2 万人）被俘，下午 3 时签署投降书。

text.en: Peter R. Mansoor, 'Operation Bagration and the Destruction of Army Group Center', Hoover Institution, 24 June 2019: the Red Army offensive into Byelorussia from 23 June to 19 August 1944 destroyed 28 of 34 divisions of the German Third Panzer, Fourth and Ninth Armies; it cost the Germans 400,000 casualties, while the Red Army suffered 180,000 killed and missing and more than half a million wounded and non-battle casualties.
text.zh: Peter R. Mansoor《巴格拉季昂行动与中央集团军群的覆灭》，胡佛研究所，2019 年 6 月 24 日：红军 1944 年 6 月 23 日至 8 月 19 日在白俄罗斯的攻势，消灭了德军第 3 装甲集团军、第 4 和第 9 集团军 34 个师中的 28 个；德军伤亡 40 万人，红军阵亡和失踪 18 万人，负伤和非战斗减员 50 万人以上。

note.en: Soviet accounts date the start to 22 June 1944, the third anniversary of the German invasion; the first attacks began on 22–23 June.
note.zh: 苏方记载开始日期为 1944 年 6 月 22 日，正是德国入侵三周年；最初的进攻在 22 至 23 日展开。

text.en: Earl F. Ziemke, Stalingrad to Berlin (US Army Center of Military History, 1968), ch. XIV, XXI–XXII: for Bagration the Soviet combat troops in the offensive zone numbered 1.2 million against an Army Group Center of slightly over 700,000, and 2.5 million with reserves; for Berlin the three Soviet fronts had 2.5 million men and 6,950 tanks; on 25 April 1945 US First Army and Soviet Fifth Guards Army met at Torgau on the Elbe; Hitler and his wife committed suicide on the afternoon of 30 April; General Weidling surrendered Berlin at 5 a.m. on 2 May; Jodl signed the unconditional surrender at Reims on 7 May, to take effect at 23.01 Central European Time on 8 May, and the ratification was completed in Berlin before midnight on 8 May.
text.zh: Earl F. Ziemke，《从斯大林格勒到柏林》（美国陆军军事历史中心，1968）第十四、二十一、二十二章：巴格拉季昂行动中，进攻地段的苏军作战部队 120 万人，对面的德国中央集团军群略多于 70 万人，连同预备队苏军共 250 万人；柏林战役中苏军三个方面军共 250 万人、6,950 辆坦克；1945 年 4 月 25 日美国第 1 集团军与苏联近卫第 5 集团军在易北河畔的托尔高会师；4 月 30 日下午希特勒和妻子自杀；5 月 2 日凌晨 5 时魏德林将军交出柏林；5 月 7 日约德尔在兰斯签署无条件投降书，8 日中欧时间 23 时 01 分生效，8 日午夜前在柏林完成批准签字。

text.en: United States Holocaust Memorial Museum, Holocaust Encyclopedia, 'Warsaw Uprising' and 'Warsaw Polish Uprising' (timeline): the Polish Home Army rose on 1 August 1944 and fought for 63 days, until 2 October; about 45,000 Home Army members took part; on 5–7 August about 40,000 men, women and children were murdered by German forces in the Wola district; the encyclopedia gives 166,000 dead in the uprising, among them perhaps as many as 17,000 Polish Jews, and elsewhere more than 180,000 victims; the Germans then razed the city centre.
text.zh: 美国大屠杀纪念馆《大屠杀百科》“华沙起义”及“华沙波兰起义”（大事记）：1944 年 8 月 1 日波兰家乡军起义，坚持 63 天，到 10 月 2 日；约 4.5 万名家乡军成员参战；8 月 5 日至 7 日，德军在沃拉区屠杀了约 4 万名男女老幼；百科记载起义中死亡 16.6 万人，其中可能有多达 1.7 万名波兰犹太人，另一处说遇难者超过 18 万；此后德军把市中心夷为平地。

note.en: Checked through search-engine extracts (the museum's site timed out). The two figures come from two pages of the same encyclopedia; both are listed.
note.zh: 通过搜索引擎摘录核对（该馆网站访问超时）。两个数字出自同一百科的两个页面，两者并列。

text.en: Congress of the United States, S. Con. Res. 23 (116th Congress, 2019), on the 75th anniversary of the Battle of the Bulge: the battle began on 16 December 1944 and ended on 25 January 1945 and resulted in over 89,000 United States casualties, including 19,000 soldiers killed, 47,500 wounded and more than 23,000 captured or missing.
text.zh: 美国国会第 116 届参议院第 23 号共同决议（2019），纪念突出部战役 75 周年：战役从 1944 年 12 月 16 日持续到 1945 年 1 月 25 日，美军伤亡 8.9 万多人，其中阵亡 1.9 万、负伤 4.75 万、被俘或失踪 2.3 万多。

note.en: The US Army official history (Cole, 1965) gives a lower total of about 81,000; figures differ by how the period is counted.
note.zh: 美国陆军官方战史（Cole，1965）的总数较低，约 8.1 万；差别来自统计的时间段不同。

text.en: Auschwitz-Birkenau State Museum, 'Overall numbers by ethnicity or category of deportee' (after Franciszek Piper, 1992): about 1.1 million people were killed at Auschwitz — about 1 million Jews, 70,000–75,000 Poles, 21,000 Roma and Sinti, 15,000 Soviet prisoners of war and 10,000–15,000 others.
text.zh: 奥斯威辛—比克瑙国家博物馆《按民族或类别统计的总人数》（据 Franciszek Piper，1992）：约 110 万人在奥斯威辛被杀害——犹太人约 100 万，波兰人 7 万至 7.5 万，罗姆人和辛提人 2.1 万，苏军战俘 1.5 万，其他 1 万至 1.5 万。

text.en: United States Holocaust Memorial Museum, Holocaust Encyclopedia, 'Soviet Forces Liberate Auschwitz' (timeline) and Auschwitz-Birkenau State Museum: on 27 January 1945 Soviet troops liberated about 7,000 prisoners, most of them ill or dying; in the preceding weeks the SS had forced tens of thousands of prisoners, mostly Jews, on death marches westward, on which at least 9,000 and probably up to 15,000 died; before leaving, the SS blew up crematoria II, III and V and burned documents.
text.zh: 美国大屠杀纪念馆《大屠杀百科》“苏军解放奥斯威辛”（大事记）及奥斯威辛—比克瑙国家博物馆：1945 年 1 月 27 日苏军解放了约 7,000 名囚犯，大多病重垂危；此前几周，党卫队强迫数万名囚犯（大多是犹太人）向西“死亡行军”，途中至少 9,000 人、可能多达 1.5 万人死亡；党卫队撤离前炸毁了第二、三、五号焚尸场，烧毁档案。

note.en: Checked through search-engine extracts (the USHMM site timed out). 27 January is International Holocaust Remembrance Day.
note.zh: 通过搜索引擎摘录核对（该馆网站访问超时）。1 月 27 日是国际大屠杀纪念日。

text.en: United States Holocaust Memorial Museum, Holocaust Encyclopedia, 'Introduction to the Holocaust' and 'How many people did the Nazis murder?' (Documenting Numbers of Victims of the Holocaust and Nazi Persecution): the Holocaust was the systematic, state-sponsored persecution and murder of six million European Jews by Nazi Germany and its allies and collaborators between 1933 and 1945; about 2.7 million were murdered at killing centres and about 2 million in mass shootings; other victims of Nazi persecution include about 3.3 million Soviet prisoners of war, at least 250,000 and possibly 500,000 Roma, and 250,000–300,000 people with disabilities living in institutions.
