text.zh: 美国大屠杀纪念馆《大屠杀百科》“大屠杀导论”与“纳粹杀害了多少人？”（大屠杀与纳粹迫害受害者人数考证）：大屠杀是纳粹德国及其盟友和协助者在 1933 至 1945 年间，有系统、由国家主导地迫害并杀害 600 万欧洲犹太人；约 270 万人在灭绝营被杀，约 200 万人死于集体枪杀；纳粹迫害的其他受害者包括约 330 万苏军战俘、至少 25 万（可能多达 50 万）罗姆人，以及 25 万至 30 万名住在收容机构的残疾人。

note.en: Checked through search-engine extracts (the museum's site timed out). The Soviet prisoner figure matches [S82].
note.zh: 通过搜索引擎摘录核对（该馆网站访问超时）。苏军战俘的数字与 [S82] 一致。

text.en: United Nations, Convention on the Prevention and Punishment of the Crime of Genocide (adopted 9 December 1948, in force 12 January 1951), Article II: genocide means acts 'committed with intent to destroy, in whole or in part, a national, ethnical, racial or religious group, as such'; the word 'genocide' was coined by the lawyer Raphael Lemkin in 1944 (Axis Rule in Occupied Europe).
text.zh: 联合国《防止及惩治灭绝种族罪公约》（1948 年 12 月 9 日通过，1951 年 1 月 12 日生效）第二条：灭绝种族指“蓄意全部或局部消灭某一民族、人种、种族或宗教团体”的行为；“灭绝种族”（genocide）一词由律师拉斐尔·莱姆金在 1944 年的《轴心国在被占领欧洲的统治》中创造。

text.en: Anne Frank House, 'Who was Anne Frank?': born in Frankfurt am Main on 12 June 1929, Anne Frank moved with her family to Amsterdam and went into hiding with her family in the Secret Annex in Amsterdam on 6 July 1942; they were discovered and arrested on 4 August 1944; they were deported via Westerbork to Auschwitz; Anne and her sister Margot were then moved to Bergen-Belsen, where both died in February 1945 of the conditions in the camp, including typhus; their father Otto was the only one of the eight people in hiding to survive.
text.zh: 安妮之家《安妮·弗兰克是谁？》：安妮·弗兰克 1929 年 6 月 12 日生于法兰克福，随家人移居阿姆斯特丹，1942 年 7 月 6 日躲进阿姆斯特丹的“密室”；1944 年 8 月 4 日被发现并逮捕；他们经韦斯特博克中转营被押往奥斯威辛；她和姐姐玛戈后来被转到贝尔根—贝尔森集中营，1945 年 2 月死于营中的恶劣条件，包括斑疹伤寒；八名藏匿者中只有父亲奥托活了下来。

note.en: Her death was long recorded officially as 31 March 1945; the Anne Frank House's research places it in February 1945, the exact date unknown.
note.zh: 官方记录长期写的是 1945 年 3 月 31 日；安妮之家的研究认为是 1945 年 2 月，确切日期不详。

text.en: Dresden Historians' Commission, final report (17 March 2010), as reported by DPA in The Local (Germany), 'Official report: Dresden bombing killed 25,000': after more than five years of research the commission concluded that up to 25,000 people were killed in the British and US raids of 13–15 February 1945, fewer than often claimed.
text.zh: 德累斯顿历史学家委员会最终报告（2010 年 3 月 17 日），据德新社在 The Local（德国）的报道《官方报告：德累斯顿轰炸致 2.5 万人死亡》：委员会经过五年多研究认定，1945 年 2 月 13 至 15 日英美空袭造成最多 2.5 万人死亡，少于通常的说法。

note.en: The National WWII Museum ('Apocalypse in Dresden', 2020) describes 35,000 as a widely accepted estimate and notes that the German government's figure is 25,000; far higher claims, up to 500,000, have been made by the far right. The first RAF wave on the night of 13 February was 240 Lancasters, the second about 550; US B-17s attacked on 14 and 15 February.
note.zh: 美国国家二战博物馆（《德累斯顿的末日》，2020）称 3.5 万是广为接受的估计，并指出德国政府的数字是 2.5 万；极右翼提出过高得多的说法，最高 50 万。2 月 13 日夜英国空军第一波 240 架兰开斯特，第二波约 550 架；美国 B-17 在 14 日和 15 日轰炸。

text.en: Center of the Tokyo Raids and War Damage (Tokyo), English guide: in the raid of 10 March 1945 the east bank of the Sumida River and neighbourhoods such as Asakusa and Nihonbashi were reduced to ash, and 'it is estimated that more than 100,000 people died that night', from burning, suffocation, drowning and cold. The National WWII Museum (Seth Paridon, 'Hellfire on Earth: Operation Meetinghouse') records that 279 B-29s dropped over 1,665 tons of incendiaries, sixteen square miles were burned out and over 1,000,000 people were left homeless.
text.zh: 东京大空袭·战灾资料中心英文介绍：1945 年 3 月 10 日空袭中，隅田川东岸以及浅草、日本桥等街区化为灰烬，“估计当夜有 10 万多人死亡”，死因有烧死、窒息、溺水和冻死。美国国家二战博物馆（Seth Paridon《人间炼狱：会议室行动》）记载：279 架 B-29 投下 1,665 多吨燃烧弹，16 平方英里被烧光，100 多万人无家可归。

text.en: National Army Museum (London), 'Battles of Imphal and Kohima': fought between 8 March and 18 July 1944; Lieutenant-General Mutaguchi led three Japanese divisions and one Indian National Army division; the Japanese Fifteenth Army, 85,000 strong, lost 53,000 dead and missing, many of them starving in the monsoon; British and Indian casualties were 12,500 at Imphal and 4,000 at Kohima; the RAF flew in nearly 19,000 tons of supplies and over 12,000 men. 'William Slim: the soldiers' soldier': Meiktila and Mandalay were captured in March 1945; 'A timeline of Burma and the Army': Rangoon was captured on 3 May 1945.
text.zh: 英国国家陆军博物馆《英帕尔与科希马战役》：战役从 1944 年 3 月 8 日打到 7 月 18 日；牟田口廉也中将指挥三个日本师团和一个印度国民军师；日军第 15 军 8.5 万人，最终死亡和失踪 5.3 万人，许多人在雨季中饿死；英印军在英帕尔伤亡 12,500 人，在科希马伤亡 4,000 人；皇家空军空运了近 1.9 万吨物资和 1.2 万多人。该馆《威廉·斯利姆》：1945 年 3 月攻占密铁拉和曼德勒；《缅甸与英国陆军大事记》：1945 年 5 月 3 日攻占仰光。

text.en: The National WWII Museum, 'The Battle of Leyte Gulf' (2024): after the Allied invasion of the Philippines at Leyte on 20 October 1944, the battle of 23–26 October was the largest naval battle ever fought; 26 Japanese ships were sunk, including three battleships, among them Musashi, and four carriers; on 25 October American escort carriers met the first organised kamikaze attacks.
text.zh: 美国国家二战博物馆《莱特湾海战》（2024）：1944 年 10 月 20 日盟军在莱特岛登陆反攻菲律宾，随后 10 月 23 日至 26 日的海战是史上规模最大的海战；日本 26 艘舰船被击沉，包括三艘战列舰（其中有武藏号）和四艘航母；10 月 25 日美国护航航母第一次遭到有组织的神风特攻。

text.en: The National WWII Museum, 'Battle of Iwo Jima': about 70,000 US Marines and 18,000 Japanese soldiers took part; in thirty-six days of fighting from 19 February 1945 nearly 7,000 Marines were killed and 20,000 wounded; Marines captured 216 Japanese soldiers and the rest were killed; the island was declared secure on 26 March 1945.
text.zh: 美国国家二战博物馆《硫磺岛战役》：约 7 万名美国海军陆战队员和 1.8 万名日军参战；从 1945 年 2 月 19 日起 36 天的战斗中，近 7,000 名陆战队员阵亡、2 万人负伤；陆战队俘虏 216 名日本士兵，其余全部战死；3 月 26 日宣布全岛肃清。

note.en: The US Marine Corps monograph (Bartley, 1954) gives 6,821 Marines killed and 'more than 20,000' Japanese defenders.
note.zh: 美国海军陆战队战史专著（Bartley，1954）记载陆战队阵亡 6,821 人，日本守军“2 万多人”。

text.en: The National WWII Museum, 'Okinawa: The Costs of Victory in the Last Battle': the battle lasted from 1 April to June 1945; American losses were 49,151, of whom 12,520 were killed or missing; some 110,000 Japanese and conscripted Okinawan defenders were killed; estimates claim that over 100,000 civilians, as much as one-third of the pre-war population, died; more than 240,000 people lost their lives in the campaign.
text.zh: 美国国家二战博物馆《冲绳：最后一战的代价》：战役从 1945 年 4 月 1 日打到 6 月；美军伤亡 49,151 人，其中阵亡或失踪 12,520 人；日军和被征召的冲绳防卫人员约 11 万人战死；估计有 10 万多名平民死亡，相当于战前人口的三分之一；整个战役中有 24 万多人丧生。

note.en: Okinawa Prefecture's Cornerstone of Peace lists 242,225 names (as of June 2024) of people of all nations who died in the battle of Okinawa and in the war in Okinawa, 149,658 of them from Okinawa.
note.zh: 冲绳县“和平基石”刻有 242,225 个名字（截至 2024 年 6 月），包括在冲绳战役和冲绳的战争中死去的各国人员，其中冲绳籍 149,658 人。

text.en: Roots.sg (National Heritage Board), 'Indian National Army Memorial' marker: the INA, set up in 1942 with Japanese assistance and later led by Subhas Chandra Bose, aimed to liberate India; the INA Monument at the Esplanade was erected in August 1945, just before the Japanese surrender, dedicated to the 'unknown warrior' of the INA and to INA members killed in the fighting in Burma; it was demolished by British forces soon after their return.
text.zh: Roots.sg（新加坡国家文物局）“印度国民军纪念碑”史迹标志：印度国民军 1942 年在日本协助下成立，后由苏巴斯·钱德拉·鲍斯领导，目标是解放印度；1945 年 8 月日本投降前夕，在滨海公园竖起印度国民军纪念碑，献给“无名战士”和在缅甸作战中阵亡的成员；英军回来后不久将它拆毁。

text.en: The National WWII Museum, 'Operation Husky: the Allied invasion of Sicily': from 10 July 1943 more than 3,000 ships landed over 150,000 ground troops in three days, covered by more than 4,000 aircraft; by 17 August the Germans had withdrawn more than 100,000 troops across the Strait of Messina. 'Rome taken: the liberation of Rome, 1944': the US Fifth Army entered Rome on 4–5 June 1944.
text.zh: 美国国家二战博物馆《哈士奇行动：盟军登陆西西里》：1943 年 7 月 10 日起，3,000 多艘舰船在三天内把 15 万多名地面部队送上岸，4,000 多架飞机掩护；到 8 月 17 日，德军把 10 万多人撤过墨西拿海峡。《攻占罗马：1944 年罗马解放》：美国第 5 集团军 1944 年 6 月 4 日至 5 日进入罗马。

text.en: US Military Academy, Department of History, campaign maps (public domain; via Wikimedia Commons): 'Operation Husky' landings and the advance to Messina (Map_operation_husky_landing.svg); 'Normandy, 13–30 June 1944', 'The Breakout, 1–13 August 1944' and 'Exploitation, 14–25 August 1944'; 'Russian offensive to the Oder, 12 January – 30 March 1945' and 'Final operations, 19 April – 7 May 1945'; 'Allied Third Burma Campaign, June 1944 – May 1945'.
text.zh: 美国西点军校历史系战役地图（公有领域，维基共享资源）：《哈士奇行动》登陆与向墨西拿推进；《诺曼底，1944 年 6 月 13–30 日》《突破，8 月 1–13 日》《扩张战果，8 月 14–25 日》；《苏军向奥得河进攻，1945 年 1 月 12 日—3 月 30 日》《最后作战，4 月 19 日—5 月 7 日》；《盟军第三次缅甸战役，1944 年 6 月—1945 年 5 月》。

text.en: City of Hiroshima, 'Frequently asked questions about the atomic bombing': the exact number of deaths is still unknown; estimates place the number of dead by the end of December 1945, when the acute effects of radiation had largely subsided, at roughly 140,000; roughly 50% of those within 1.2 km of the hypocentre are estimated to have died on the day, and 80–100% closer to it.
text.zh: 广岛市《关于原子弹爆炸的常见问题》：确切死亡人数至今不明；估计到 1945 年 12 月底，即急性放射病的影响大体过去时，死亡约 14 万人；距爆心 1.2 公里以内的人估计约一半当天死亡，越靠近爆心比例越高，达到八成到全部。

text.en: Radiation Effects Research Foundation (Hiroshima and Nagasaki; a Japan–US research body), FAQ: estimated acute deaths within two to four months of the bombings were 90,000–166,000 in Hiroshima (population 340,000–350,000) and 60,000–80,000 in Nagasaki (population 250,000–270,000); exact totals are unknown because records were destroyed and whole families died.
text.zh: 放射线影响研究所（广岛、长崎，日美合办的研究机构）常见问题：原子弹爆炸后两到四个月内的急性死亡人数，广岛估计 9 万至 16.6 万（当时人口 34 万至 35 万），长崎 6 万至 8 万（人口 25 万至 27 万）；由于档案被毁、整户人家死亡，确切总数无法知道。

text.en: Nagasaki City, Nagasaki Peace site, 'Damage caused by the atomic bombing': Nagasaki had a population of about 240,000; by the end of December 1945, 73,884 of its people had been killed and 74,909 injured by the bomb (report of the Committee for the Preservation of Atomic Bomb Artifacts, 1950).
text.zh: 长崎市“长崎和平”网站《原子弹造成的损害》：长崎当时人口约 24 万；到 1945 年 12 月底，原子弹造成 73,884 人死亡、74,909 人受伤（原子弹资料保存委员会 1950 年报告）。

text.en: Manhattan Engineer District (US Army), The Atomic Bombings of Hiroshima and Nagasaki (report, June 1946): at 8.15 a.m. on 6 August 1945 the bomb destroyed more than 4 square miles of Hiroshima, and 66,000 people were killed and 69,000 injured; at 11.02 a.m. on 9 August the second bomb destroyed 1.5 square miles of Nagasaki, killing 39,000 and injuring 25,000.
text.zh: 美国陆军曼哈顿工程区《广岛和长崎的原子弹轰炸》（1946 年 6 月报告）：1945 年 8 月 6 日上午 8 时 15 分，原子弹摧毁广岛 4 平方英里以上，66,000 人死亡、69,000 人受伤；8 月 9 日上午 11 时 02 分，第二颗原子弹摧毁长崎 1.5 平方英里，39,000 人死亡、25,000 人受伤。

note.en: An early count made within a year of the bombings; later Japanese estimates (S152–S154) are about twice as high, mainly because they include people who died of injuries and radiation by the end of 1945.
note.zh: 这是轰炸后一年内的早期统计；后来日方的估计（S152–S154）大约高出一倍，主要因为计入了到 1945 年底死于伤势和辐射的人。

text.en: David M. Glantz, August Storm: The Soviet 1945 Strategic Offensive in Manchuria (Leavenworth Paper No. 7, Combat Studies Institute, US Army Command and General Staff College, 1983): shortly after midnight on 9 August 1945 Soviet troops crossed the Manchurian border; the Far East Command numbered 1,577,725 men — Trans-Baikal Front 654,040, 1st Far Eastern Front 586,589 and 2nd Far Eastern Front 337,096 — with 5,556 tanks and self-propelled guns; Japanese and puppet forces totalled about 1,217,000; the main operation was completed in seven days, by 16 August, with the battle of Mutanchiang on 14–16 August and the 15th Army's advance up the Sungari to Chiamussu; Soviet estimates put Japanese losses at 84,000 killed and 594,000 prisoners, and Soviet losses at 8,000 killed and 24,000 wounded.
text.zh: David M. Glantz《八月风暴：1945 年苏联在满洲的战略进攻》（《莱文沃思文集》第 7 号，美国陆军指挥与参谋学院战斗研究所，1983）：1945 年 8 月 9 日午夜刚过，苏军越过满洲边界；远东方面军总兵力 1,577,725 人——外贝加尔方面军 654,040 人、远东第一方面军 586,589 人、远东第二方面军 337,096 人，坦克和自行火炮 5,556 辆；日本和傀儡军队共约 121.7 万人；主要作战七天内、到 8 月 16 日完成，其中牡丹江之战在 8 月 14 日至 16 日，第 15 集团军沿松花江推进到佳木斯；苏方估计日军阵亡 8.4 万、被俘 59.4 万，苏军阵亡 8,000、负伤 2.4 万。

text.en: David M. Glantz, August Storm (1983), Map 29, '1st Far Eastern Front operations, 9–20 August 1945' (US Government work, public domain; via Wikimedia Commons), with Map 21 (Trans-Baikal Front, 9–19 August) and Map 39 (2nd Far Eastern Front) in the same paper.
text.zh: David M. Glantz《八月风暴》（1983）地图 29“远东第一方面军作战，1945 年 8 月 9–20 日”（美国政府作品，公有领域，维基共享资源），以及同书地图 21（外贝加尔方面军，8 月 9–19 日）和地图 39（远东第二方面军）。

text.en: Imperial Rescript on the Termination of the War, broadcast by Emperor Hirohito at noon on 15 August 1945 (English text, Atomic Heritage Foundation): 'the war situation has developed not necessarily to Japan's advantage'; 'the enemy has begun to employ a new and most cruel bomb'; the word 'surrender' does not appear.
text.zh: 1945 年 8 月 15 日正午裕仁天皇广播的《终战诏书》（英译文，原子遗产基金会）：“战局未必好转”；“敌方新使用残虐之炸弹”；全文没有出现“投降”一词。

text.en: US National Archives, 'Surrender of Japan (1945)': the Instrument of Surrender was signed aboard USS Missouri in Tokyo Bay at 9.04 a.m. on 2 September 1945 by Foreign Minister Shigemitsu Mamoru and General Umezu Yoshijirō for Japan and by General Douglas MacArthur for the Allied Powers, followed by representatives of the United States, China, the United Kingdom, the Soviet Union, Australia, Canada, France, the Netherlands and New Zealand.
text.zh: 美国国家档案馆《日本投降（1945）》：1945 年 9 月 2 日上午 9 时 04 分，在东京湾的密苏里号上，外务大臣重光葵和梅津美治郎大将代表日本，麦克阿瑟将军代表盟国签署投降书，随后美国、中国、英国、苏联、澳大利亚、加拿大、法国、荷兰、新西兰的代表签字。

text.en: Xinhua, 27 February 2014 (National People's Congress website): the NPC Standing Committee ratified 3 September as the Victory Day of the Chinese People's War of Resistance against Japanese Aggression; the government had designated 3 September in 1951, the day after Japan formally signed the instrument of surrender.
text.zh: 新华社 2014 年 2 月 27 日（全国人大网站）：全国人大常委会决定将 9 月 3 日定为中国人民抗日战争胜利纪念日；1951 年政府已把这一天定为纪念日，即日本正式签署投降书的第二天。

text.en: S. Woodburn Kirby and others, The War Against Japan, vol. V: The Surrender of Japan (HMSO, 1969), pp. 249, 265–273: Rear-Admiral Holland in the cruiser Sussex arrived off Singapore on 4 September 1945 escorting the convoys carrying 5th Indian Division and XV Corps headquarters from Rangoon; that evening General Itagaki and Vice-Admiral Fukudome signed aboard Sussex the surrender of Singapore and Johore, where Japanese strength was 50,118 army and air force and 26,872 naval personnel; the occupation began at 11 a.m. on 5 September; on 12 September, in the Municipal Buildings, Mountbatten accepted the surrender of all Japanese forces in South-East Asia and Itagaki signed eleven copies of the Instrument of Surrender; by the end of September some 53,700 prisoners and internees had been evacuated from South-East Asia, mostly by sea from Singapore, and by May 1946 South-East Asia Command had recovered 80,419 prisoners of war and 16,156 internees.
text.zh: S. Woodburn Kirby 等，《对日战争》第五卷《日本投降》（英国皇家文书局，1969）第 249、265–273 页：1945 年 9 月 4 日，霍兰少将乘萨塞克斯号巡洋舰护送从仰光运载印度第 5 师和第 15 军军部的船队抵达新加坡外海；当晚板垣征四郎大将和福留繁海军中将在萨塞克斯号上签署新加坡和柔佛的投降书，当地日军有陆军和航空兵 50,118 人、海军 26,872 人；9 月 5 日上午 11 时开始占领；9 月 12 日，蒙巴顿在市政大厦接受东南亚全部日军投降，板垣签署了十一份投降书；到 9 月底已有约 53,700 名战俘和被拘留者撤离东南亚，大多经海路从新加坡出发；到 1946 年 5 月，东南亚司令部共接回战俘 80,419 人、被拘留平民 16,156 人。

text.en: IMTFE judgment (1948), ch. VIII: of 235,473 prisoners from the United States and United Kingdom forces taken by the German and Italian armies, 9,348, or 4 per cent, died in captivity; in the Pacific theatre, of 132,134 prisoners taken by the Japanese from the United States and United Kingdom forces alone, 35,756, or 27 per cent, died.
text.zh: 远东国际军事法庭判决书（1948）第八章：被德意军队俘虏的 235,473 名美英战俘中，9,348 人（4%）死于关押期间；在太平洋战场，仅美英两国被日军俘虏的 132,134 人中，就有 35,756 人（27%）死亡。

note.en: US and UK prisoners only; Dutch, Australian, Indian and other Allied prisoners and the Asian labourers are not included.
note.zh: 只计美英战俘，不含荷兰、澳大利亚、印度等其他盟国战俘和亚洲劳工。

text.en: Documentation Center Nazi Party Rally Grounds (Nuremberg municipal museums), 'War and genocide': genocide and the Second World War took a toll estimated at more than 60 million lives.
text.zh: 纽伦堡纳粹党集会场文献中心（纽伦堡市立博物馆）《战争与种族灭绝》：种族灭绝和第二次世界大战夺去的生命估计超过 6,000 万。

text.en: Ministry of Health, Labour and Welfare of Japan, public-relations magazine (August 2022): about 3.1 million Japanese died in the Pacific War, about 2.3 million of them military personnel and civilian employees of the armed forces.
text.zh: 日本厚生劳动省宣传刊物（2022 年 8 月）：太平洋战争中死亡的日本人约 310 万，其中军人和军属约 230 万。

note.en: The remaining 800,000 or so were civilians, including those killed in air raids, the atomic bombings, Okinawa and overseas.
note.zh: 其余约 80 万是平民，包括死于空袭、原子弹、冲绳战役和海外的人。

text.en: The National WWII Museum, 'The Tokyo War Crimes Trials': the International Military Tribunal for the Far East, with judges from eleven countries, tried 28 defendants, mostly military officers and government officials, from 3 May 1946 to 12 November 1948; seven were sentenced to death by hanging and sixteen to life imprisonment; the executions took place at Sugamo Prison on 23 December 1948.
text.zh: 美国国家二战博物馆《东京战犯审判》：远东国际军事法庭由十一国法官组成，1946 年 5 月 3 日至 1948 年 11 月 12 日审判 28 名被告，大多是军官和政府官员；七人被判绞刑，十六人终身监禁；1948 年 12 月 23 日在巢鸭监狱执行死刑。

text.en: SG101 (Government of Singapore), 'Singapore in State of Emergency': after three European planters were killed by communist guerrillas in Perak on 16 June 1948, Britain declared a state of Emergency in Malaya two days later and Singapore followed on 24 June 1948; the Emergency lasted twelve years, until 1960.
text.zh: SG101（新加坡政府）《新加坡进入紧急状态》：1948 年 6 月 16 日三名欧洲种植园主在霹雳州被共产党游击队杀害，两天后英国宣布马来亚进入紧急状态，新加坡 1948 年 6 月 24 日跟进；紧急状态持续 12 年，到 1960 年结束。

text.en: Roots.sg (National Heritage Board), 'The Singapore Story through 60 Objects: Proclamation of the Republic of Singapore, 9 August 1965': on 9 August 1965 Singapore separated from Malaysia and Prime Minister Lee Kuan Yew proclaimed it a sovereign, democratic and independent nation.
text.zh: Roots.sg（新加坡国家文物局）《60 件文物里的新加坡故事：新加坡共和国宣言，1965 年 8 月 9 日》：1965 年 8 月 9 日新加坡脱离马来西亚，总理李光耀宣布新加坡成为主权、民主和独立的国家。

text.en: Roots.sg (National Museum of Singapore collection), 'Civilian War Memorial': the memorial on Beach Road to the civilians who died during the Japanese occupation was unveiled by Prime Minister Lee Kuan Yew on 15 February 1967, the 25th anniversary of the fall of Singapore; its four 68-metre pillars, known as 'the chopsticks', stand over a burial chamber holding the remains exhumed from mass graves discovered in the Siglap area in 1962, thought to be victims of the Sook Ching.
text.zh: Roots.sg（新加坡国家博物馆藏品）《日据时期死难人民纪念碑》：这座位于美芝路、纪念日据时期死难平民的纪念碑，由总理李光耀于 1967 年 2 月 15 日（新加坡沦陷 25 周年）揭幕；四根 68 米高的柱子俗称“筷子”，下面的墓室安放着 1962 年在实里达一带集体坟场发掘出的遗骸，相信是肃清的遇难者。

text.en: Home Team NS (Singapore), 'Total Defence': the first Total Defence Day was observed on 15 February 1984; the date was chosen as the day Singapore fell to the Japanese in 1942.
text.zh: Home Team NS（新加坡）《全面防卫》：第一个全面防卫日在 1984 年 2 月 15 日；选这一天，是因为 1942 年新加坡在这一天落入日军之手。

text.en: Potsdam Declaration, 26 July 1945 (text, National Diet Library of Japan): the United States, United Kingdom and China called on Japan to proclaim the unconditional surrender of all its armed forces; 'the alternative for Japan is prompt and utter destruction'.
text.zh: 《波茨坦公告》，1945 年 7 月 26 日（日本国立国会图书馆藏文本）：美、英、中要求日本宣布所有武装部队无条件投降；“否则日本即将迅速完全毁灭”。

text.en: President Harry S. Truman, radio report to the American people on the Potsdam Conference, 9 August 1945 (American Presidency Project): 'We have used it in order to shorten the agony of war, in order to save the lives of thousands and thousands of young Americans.'
text.zh: 杜鲁门总统 1945 年 8 月 9 日就波茨坦会议向美国人民的广播讲话（美国总统档案项目）：“我们使用它，是为了缩短战争的痛苦，为了拯救成千上万美国年轻人的生命。”

text.en: Henry L. Stimson, 'The Decision to Use the Atomic Bomb', Harper's Magazine, February 1947 (Atomic Heritage Foundation): the former Secretary of War wrote that an invasion of Japan might be expected to cost 'over a million casualties, to American forces alone', with major fighting lasting until the latter part of 1946 at the earliest.
text.zh: 亨利·史汀生《使用原子弹的决定》，《哈泼斯杂志》1947 年 2 月（原子遗产基金会）：这位前陆军部长写道，进攻日本本土预计将使“仅美军就伤亡 100 多万”，大规模战斗最早也要打到 1946 年下半年。

note.en: Written after the war in defence of the decision; the casualty estimates made by US planners in mid-1945 for the first phase of an invasion were considerably lower.
note.zh: 这是战后为这一决定辩护时写的；1945 年年中美国参谋人员对登陆第一阶段伤亡的估计要低得多。

text.en: Report of the Committee on Political and Social Problems ('Franck Report'), Manhattan Project scientists, Chicago, 11 June 1945 (Atomic Heritage Foundation): the scientists urged that nuclear bombs should 'first be revealed to the world by a demonstration in an appropriately selected uninhabited area'.
text.zh: 《政治与社会问题委员会报告》（“弗兰克报告”），曼哈顿计划科学家，芝加哥，1945 年 6 月 11 日（原子遗产基金会）：科学家们主张原子弹应当“先在适当选择的无人区做示范，向世界展示”。

text.en: United States Strategic Bombing Survey, Summary Report (Pacific War), 1 July 1946, p. 26: 'certainly prior to 31 December 1945, and in all probability prior to 1 November 1945, Japan would have surrendered even if the atomic bombs had not been dropped, even if Russia had not entered the war, and even if no invasion had been planned or contemplated.'
text.zh: 美国战略轰炸调查团《总结报告（太平洋战争）》，1946 年 7 月 1 日，第 26 页：“可以肯定在 1945 年 12 月 31 日之前，而且很可能在 1945 年 11 月 1 日之前，即使不投原子弹、即使苏联不参战、即使没有计划或考虑登陆，日本也会投降。”

note.en: Later historians have disputed this conclusion as well as Stimson's; the debate continues.
note.zh: 后来的历史学家对这一结论和史汀生的说法都有质疑，争论至今没有结束。
